17.12.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
gaṃgodakaṃ madhughṛte kuṃkumāgurucaṃda nam ..
guggulaṃ bilvapatrāṇi bakapuṣpaṃ ca yo vahet .. 1 ..
17.12.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
गंगोदकं मधुघृते कुंकुमागुरुचंद नम् ..
गुग्गुलं बिल्वपत्राणि बकपुष्पं च यो वहेत् .. 1 ..
17.12.m: Sārasvata said: / Gaṅgā water, honey, ghee, saffron, agallochum, sandalwood, / bdellium, bilva leaves, and bakula flowers—whoever carries these; 1

17.12.s:
padacārī śucitanurbhāraṃ skandhe nidhāya ca ..
tīrthe snātvā śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ priyam .. 2 ..
17.12.d:
पदचारी शुचितनुर्भारं स्कन्धे निधाय च ..
तीर्थे स्नात्वा शिवं विष्णुं ब्रह्माणं शंकरं प्रियम् .. 2 ..
17.12.m: walking on foot, pure in body, placing the load upon his shoulder, / having bathed at the sacred ford, and having seen Śiva, Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and dear Śaṃkara; 2

17.12.s:
dṛṣṭvā nivedayedyastu sa muktaḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ ..
sa naro gaṇatāṃ yāti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 3 ..
17.12.d:
दृष्ट्वा निवेदयेद्यस्तु स मुक्तः सर्वबन्धनैः ..
स नरो गणतां याति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 3 ..
17.12.m: whoever offers [these] is released from all bonds; / that man attains the status of an attendant until the dissolution of all beings. 3

17.12.s:
kalatramitraputrairvā bhrātṛbhiḥ svajanairnaraiḥ ..
sahito vā narairyāti tīrthe devaṃ viciṃtya ca .. 4 ..
17.12.d:
कलत्रमित्रपुत्रैर्वा भ्रातृभिः स्वजनैर्नरैः ..
सहितो वा नरैर्याति तीर्थे देवं विचिंत्य च .. 4 ..
17.12.m: Whether accompanied by wife, friends, sons, brothers, kinsmen, / or along with other men, he goes to the sacred ford meditating on the Lord; 4

17.12.s:
devamūrtiṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā rathasthāṃ supratiṣṭhitām ..
candanāgurukarpūrairarcitāṃ kuṃkumena ca .. 5 ..
17.12.d:
देवमूर्तिं शुभां कृत्वा रथस्थां सुप्रतिष्ठिताम् ..
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरैरर्चितां कुंकुमेन च .. 5 ..
17.12.m: having fashioned an auspicious divine image, placed upon a chariot and well consecrated, / worshipped with sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, and saffron; 5

17.12.s:
pūjayanvividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpādikairnṛpa ..
gītanṛtyaiḥ savāditrairhāsyalāsyairanekadhā .. 6 ..
17.12.d:
पूजयन्विविधैः पुष्पैर्धूपदीपादिकैर्नृप ..
गीतनृत्यैः सवादित्रैर्हास्यलास्यैरनेकधा .. 6 ..
17.12.m: worshipping [it] with various flowers, incense, lamps, and the like, O king, / with singing, dancing, instruments, and varied playful dances; 6

17.12.s:
dharitrīṃ kāṃcanaṃ gāśca jalānnavasanāni ca ..
tṛṇendhane priyāṃ vāṇīṃ yacchanyāti naro yadi .. 7 ..
17.12.d:
धरित्रीं कांचनं गाश्च जलान्नवसनानि च ..
तृणेन्धने प्रियां वाणीं यच्छन्याति नरो यदि .. 7 ..
17.12.m: if a man goes giving land, gold, cows, water, food, garments, / grass, firewood, and kind words; 7

17.12.s:
devāṃganākaragrāhagṛhīto nandanaṃ vanam ..
prāpya bhuṃkte śubhānbhogānyāvadācandratārakam .. 8 ..
17.12.d:
देवांगनाकरग्राहगृहीतो नन्दनं वनम् ..
प्राप्य भुंक्ते शुभान्भोगान्यावदाचन्द्रतारकम् .. 8 ..
17.12.m: taken by the hand by divine maidens, reaching the Nandana grove, / he enjoys auspicious pleasures as long as the moon and stars endure. 8

17.12.s:
tīrthe saṃcaritaḥ puruṣo rogaiḥ prāṇānvimuñcati ..
adṛṣṭvā daivataṃ tīrthe dṛṣṭatīrthaphalaṃ labhet .. 9 ..
17.12.d:
तीर्थे संचरितः पुरुषो रोगैः प्राणान्विमुञ्चति ..
अदृष्ट्वा दैवतं तीर्थे दृष्टतीर्थफलं लभेत् .. 9 ..
17.12.m: If a man wandering in a sacred ford gives up his life through diseases, / even without seeing the deity at the sacred ford, he obtains the fruit of having seen the sacred ford.

17.12.s:
saṃsāradoṣānvividhānvicintya strīputramitreṣvapi baṃdhamuktaḥ ..
vijñāya baddhaṃ puruṣaṃ pradhānaiḥ sa sarvatīrthāni karoti deham .. 7.2.12.10 ..
17.12.d:
संसारदोषान्विविधान्विचिन्त्य स्त्रीपुत्रमित्रेष्वपि बंधमुक्तः ..
विज्ञाय बद्धं पुरुषं प्रधानैः स सर्वतीर्थानि करोति देहम् .. 7.2.12.10 ..
17.12.m: Having reflected upon the various defects of saṃsāra, freed from attachment even toward wife, sons, and friends, / and knowing the soul to be bound by the primary elements, he turns his very body into all the sacred fords.

17.12.s:
ājanmajanmāṃntarasaṃcitāni dagdhvā sa pāpāni naro narendra ..
tejomayaṃ sarvagataṃ purāṇaṃ bhavodbhavaṃ paśyati mucyate saḥ ..11..
17.12.d:
आजन्मजन्मांन्तरसंचितानि दग्ध्वा स पापानि नरो नरेन्द्र ..
तेजोमयं सर्वगतं पुराणं भवोद्भवं पश्यति मुच्यते सः ..11..
17.12.m: Having burned away the sins accumulated throughout this birth and other births, O king of men, / he beholds the luminous, all-pervading, ancient source of existence, and is liberated.

17.12.s:
tīrthe vipravaco grāhyaṃ snātvā saṃdhyārcanādikam ..
darbhāstilā haviṣyānnaṃ prayogāḥ śraddhayā kṛtāḥ ..12..
17.12.d:
तीर्थे विप्रवचो ग्राह्यं स्नात्वा संध्यार्चनादिकम् ..
दर्भास्तिला हविष्यान्नं प्रयोगाः श्रद्धया कृताः ..12..
17.12.m: At a sacred ford, the word of a brahmin should be received; having bathed, performing twilight worship and the like, / with darbha grass, sesame seeds, sacrificial grain, and rites performed with faith;

17.12.s:
agastyaṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ ca puṣpaṃ śatadalaṃ śubham ..
karpūrāguruśrīkhaṃḍaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tulasīdalam .. 13 ..
17.12.d:
अगस्त्यं भृङ्गराजं च पुष्पं शतदलं शुभम् ..
कर्पूरागुरुश्रीखंडं कुंकुमं तुलसीदलम् .. 13 ..
17.12.m: with Agastya and Bhṛṅgarāja [flowers], the auspicious hundred-petaled lotus, / camphor, agallochum, sandalwood, saffron, and a tulasī leaf;

17.12.s:
bilvapramāṇapiṃḍeṣu dīpoddyotitabhūmiṣu ..
tāṃbūla phalanaivedyaṃ tiladarbhodakena ca .. 14 ..
17.12.d:
बिल्वप्रमाणपिंडेषु दीपोद्द्योतितभूमिषु ..
तांबूल फलनैवेद्यं तिलदर्भोदकेन च .. 14 ..
17.12.m: with rice balls the size of bilva fruits upon grounds illuminated by lamps, / with betel, fruit-offerings, and water with sesame and darbha grass.

17.12.s:
tīrthe saṃkalpitaṃ martyaistadanaṃtaṃ prajāyate ..
ayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇeṣu ca .. 15 ..
17.12.d:
तीर्थे संकल्पितं मर्त्यैस्तदनंतं प्रजायते ..
अयने विषुवे चैव संक्रांतौ ग्रहणेषु च .. 15 ..
17.12.m: Whatever is dedicated by mortals at a sacred ford becomes endless: / at the solstices, the equinoxes, the solar transitions, and during eclipses;

17.12.s:
māsāṃte'para pakṣe tu kṣayāhe pitṛmātṛke ..
gajacchāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ dravye prāptau dvijottamaḥ .. 16 ..
17.12.d:
मासांतेऽपर पक्षे तु क्षयाहे पितृमातृके ..
गजच्छायां त्रयोदश्यां द्रव्ये प्राप्तौ द्विजोत्तमः .. 16 ..
17.12.m: at the end of the month, during the dark fortnight, on the death anniversary of father or mother, / during the elephant's shadow, on the thirteenth day, or when wealth is obtained, O best of the twice-born.

17.12.s:
gṛhe śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṝṇāmṛṇamuktaye ..
gṛhācchataguṇaṃ nadyāṃ yā nadī yāti sāgaram .. 17 ..
17.12.d:
गृहे श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत पितॄणामृणमुक्तये ..
गृहाच्छतगुणं नद्यां या नदी याति सागरम् .. 17 ..
17.12.m: One should perform a śrāddha at home for release from the debt to the ancestors; / [the merit is] a hundred times greater than at home at a river that flows to the ocean.

17.12.s:
prabhāse puṣkare rājangaṃgāyāṃ piṃḍatārake ..
prayāge nṛpagomatyāṃ bhavadāmodarāgrataḥ .. 18 ..
17.12.d:
प्रभासे पुष्करे राजन्गंगायां पिंडतारके ..
प्रयागे नृपगोमत्यां भवदामोदराग्रतः .. 18 ..
17.12.m: At Prabhāsa, at Puṣkara, O king, at the Gaṅgā, at Piṇḍatāraka, / at Prayāga, O king, at the Gomatī, before Bhava and Dāmodara;

17.12.s:
narmadādiṣu tīrtheṣu kuryācchrāddhaṃ naro yadi ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitaro yāṃti sadgatim.. 19 ..
17.12.d:
नर्मदादिषु तीर्थेषु कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं नरो यदि ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः पितरो यांति सद्गतिम्.. 19 ..
17.12.m: if a man should perform a śrāddha at the sacred fords such as the Narmadā, / he is fully freed from all sins, and his ancestors attain the good realm.

17.12.s:
saṃtānamuttamaṃ labdhvā bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān ..
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya prānte yāti surālayam.. 7.2.12.20 ..
17.12.d:
संतानमुत्तमं लब्ध्वा भुक्त्वा भोगाननुत्तमान् ..
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य प्रान्ते याति सुरालयम्.. 7.2.12.20 ..
17.12.m: Having obtained excellent progeny and enjoyed unsurpassed pleasures, / he ascends a divine aerial chariot and at the end goes to the abode of the gods.

17.12.s:
jātakarmādiyajñeṣu vivāhe yajñakarmaṇi ..
devapratiṣṭhāprāraṃbhe vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ prakalpayet .. 21 ..
17.12.d:
जातकर्मादियज्ञेषु विवाहे यज्ञकर्मणि ..
देवप्रतिष्ठाप्रारंभे वृद्धिश्राद्धं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 21 ..
17.12.m: In rites such as the birth ceremonies, at marriages, during sacrifices, / and at the commencement of the consecration of a deity, one should perform a vṛddhiśrāddha.

17.12.s:
tṛpyanti devatāḥ sarvā stṛpyaṃti pitaro nṛṇām..
vṛddhiśrāddhakṛto gehe jāyate sarvamaṃgalam .. 22 ..
17.12.d:
तृप्यन्ति देवताः सर्वा स्तृप्यंति पितरो नृणाम्..
वृद्धिश्राद्धकृतो गेहे जायते सर्वमंगलम् .. 22 ..
17.12.m: All the deities are satisfied, and the ancestors of men are satisfied; / all auspiciousness arises in the house of one who performs a vṛddhiśrāddha.

17.12.s:
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madyamadādayaḥ ..
māyā mātsaryapaiśunyamaviveko vicāraṇā .. 23 ..
17.12.d:
कामः क्रोधश्च लोभश्च मोहो मद्यमदादयः ..
माया मात्सर्यपैशुन्यमविवेको विचारणा .. 23 ..
17.12.m: Desire, anger, greed, delusion, intoxication from liquor and other causes, / deceit, envy, slander, lack of discernment, overthinking,

17.12.s:
ahaṃkāro yadṛcchā ca cāpalyaṃ laulyatā nṛpa ..
atyāyāsopyanāyāsaḥ pramādo drohasāhasam .. 24 ..
17.12.d:
अहंकारो यदृच्छा च चापल्यं लौल्यता नृप ..
अत्यायासोप्यनायासः प्रमादो द्रोहसाहसम् .. 24 ..
17.12.m: arrogance, self-will, fickleness, longing, O king, / excessive exertion, total indolence, negligence, treachery, recklessness,

17.12.s:
ālasyaṃ dīrghasūtratvaṃ paradāropasevanam ..
alpāhāro nirāhāraḥ śokaścauryaṃ nṛpottama .. 25 ..
17.12.d:
आलस्यं दीर्घसूत्रत्वं परदारोपसेवनम् ..
अल्पाहारो निराहारः शोकश्चौर्यं नृपोत्तम .. 25 ..
17.12.m: laziness, procrastination, consorting with another's wife, / eating too little, total fasting, grief, theft, O best of kings—

17.12.s:
etāndoṣāngṛhe nityaṃ varjayanyadi vartate ..
sa naro maṇḍanaṃ bhūmerdeśasya nagarasya ca .. 26 ..
17.12.d:
एतान्दोषान्गृहे नित्यं वर्जयन्यदि वर्तते ..
स नरो मण्डनं भूमेर्देशस्य नगरस्य च .. 26 ..
17.12.m: if one lives at home continually avoiding these defects, / that man is an ornament to the earth, to the country, and to the city.

17.12.s:
śrīmānvidvānkulīno'sau sa eva puruṣottamaḥ ..
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaśca nityaṃ tasya prajāyate .. 27 ..
17.12.d:
श्रीमान्विद्वान्कुलीनोऽसौ स एव पुरुषोत्तमः ..
सर्वतीर्थाभिषेकश्च नित्यं तस्य प्रजायते .. 27 ..
17.12.m: He is fortunate, learned, of noble birth, he alone is the best of men; / the ablution of all the sacred fords is daily accomplished for him.

17.12.s:
tadā tīrthaphalaṃ samyaktyaktadoṣasya jāyate ..
snānaṃ sandhyā japo homaḥ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam ..
śrāddhaṃ devasya pūjā ca tyaktadoṣasya jāyate .. 28 ..
17.12.d:
तदा तीर्थफलं सम्यक्त्यक्तदोषस्य जायते ..
स्नानं सन्ध्या जपो होमः पितृदेवर्षितर्पणम् ..
श्राद्धं देवस्य पूजा च त्यक्तदोषस्य जायते .. 28 ..
17.12.m: Then the fruit of the sacred ford is fully realized for one who has abandoned defects; / bathing, twilight prayers, silent recitation, fire offerings, libations to ancestors, gods, and seers, / śrāddha, and worship of the deity are fruitful for one who has abandoned defects.

17.12.s:
prayāge vā kurukṣetre sarasvatyāṃ ca sāgare ..
gayāyāṃ vā rudrapade naranārāyaṇāśrame .. 29 ..
17.12.d:
प्रयागे वा कुरुक्षेत्रे सरस्वत्यां च सागरे ..
गयायां वा रुद्रपदे नरनारायणाश्रमे .. 29 ..
17.12.m: Whether at Prayāga, or at Kurukṣetra, and at the Sarasvatī, or at the ocean, / or at Gayā, at Rudrapada, or at the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa,

17.12.s:
prabhāse puṣkare kṛṣṇe gomatyāṃ piṃḍatārake ..
vastrāpathe girau puṇye tathā dāmodare nṛpa .. 7.2.12.30 ..
17.12.d:
प्रभासे पुष्करे कृष्णे गोमत्यां पिंडतारके ..
वस्त्रापथे गिरौ पुण्ये तथा दामोदरे नृप .. 7.2.12.30 ..
17.12.m: at Prabhāsa, at Puṣkara, at Kṛṣṇā, at the Gomatī, at Piṇḍatāraka, / in Vastrāpatha on the holy mountain, and likewise at Dāmodara, O king,

17.12.s:
bhīmeśvare narmadāyāṃ skāṃde rāmeśvarādiṣu ..
ujjayinyāṃ mahākāle vārāṇasyāṃ ca bhūrbhuvaḥ .. 31 ..
17.12.d:
भीमेश्वरे नर्मदायां स्कांदे रामेश्वरादिषु ..
उज्जयिन्यां महाकाले वाराणस्यां च भूर्भुवः .. 31 ..
17.12.m: at Bhīmeśvara, on the Narmadā, at Skānda, at Rāmeśvara and others, / in Ujjayinī at Mahākāla, and at Vārāṇasī, [which encompass] the earth and atmosphere,

17.12.s:
kāliṃdyāṃ mathurāyāṃ ca sakṛdyāti naro yadi ..
sadoṣo mucyate doṣairbrahmahatyādibhiḥ kṛtaiḥ .. .. 32 ..
17.12.d:
कालिंद्यां मथुरायां च सकृद्याति नरो यदि ..
सदोषो मुच्यते दोषैर्ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः कृतैः .. .. 32 ..
17.12.m: at the Kālindī and at Mathurā, if a man goes even once, / [though] tainted with fault, he is freed from faults committed, such as the killing of a brahmin.

17.12.s:
api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā pakṣī vā sūkaro'pi vā ..
kharoṣṭrakuṃjarā vājimṛgasiṃhasarīsṛpāḥ .. 33 ..
17.12.d:
अपि कीटः पतंगो वा पक्षी वा सूकरोऽपि वा ..
खरोष्ट्रकुंजरा वाजिमृगसिंहसरीसृपाः .. 33 ..
17.12.m: Even a worm, a moth, a bird, or a hog, / donkeys, camels, elephants, horses, deer, lions, reptiles,

17.12.s:
jñānato'jñānato rājaṃsteṣu sthā neṣu ye mṛtāḥ ..
sarve te puṇyakarmāṇaḥ svargaṃ bhuktvā sukhaṃ bahu .. 34 ..
17.12.d:
ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो राजंस्तेषु स्था नेषु ये मृताः ..
सर्वे ते पुण्यकर्माणः स्वर्गं भुक्त्वा सुखं बहु .. 34 ..
17.12.m: those who die in these places knowingly or unknowingly, O king, / all of them are performers of meritorious deeds; having enjoyed great happiness in heaven,

17.12.s:
caturvarṇeṣu sarve te jāyaṃte karmabaṃdhanāt ..
karmabaṃdhaṃ vihāyāśu muktiṃ yāṃti narāḥ punaḥ .. 35 ..
17.12.d:
चतुर्वर्णेषु सर्वे ते जायंते कर्मबंधनात् ..
कर्मबंधं विहायाशु मुक्तिं यांति नराः पुनः .. 35 ..
17.12.m: all of them are born among the four castes by virtue of their karmic bond; / leaving behind the bond of karma, those men quickly attain liberation again.

17.12.s:
modaṃte tīrthamaraṇātsvargabhogāvasānataḥ ..
saṃprāpya bhārate khaṃḍe karmabhūmiṃ mahodayam .. 36 ..
17.12.d:
मोदंते तीर्थमरणात्स्वर्गभोगावसानतः ..
संप्राप्य भारते खंडे कर्मभूमिं महोदयम् .. 36 ..
17.12.m: They rejoice on account of death at a sacred ford, after the enjoyment of heaven has ended, / having reached the land of action, the great fortune, in the continent of Bhārata.

17.12.s:
anekāścaryasaṃyuktaṃ bahuparvatamaṃḍitam ..
gaṃgāyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudraiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ .. 37 ..
17.12.d:
अनेकाश्चर्यसंयुक्तं बहुपर्वतमंडितम् ..
गंगायाः सरितः सर्वाः समुद्रैः सह संगताः .. 37 ..
17.12.m: Endowed with many wonders, adorned with many mountains, / where all the rivers of the Gaṅgā unite with the oceans,

17.12.s:
padepade nidhānāni saṃti tīrthānyanekaśaḥ ..
yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 38 ..
17.12.d:
पदेपदे निधानानि संति तीर्थान्यनेकशः ..
येषां स्मरणमात्रेण सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 38 ..
17.12.m: at every step there are treasures, countless sacred fords, / by the mere remembrance of which the destruction of all sins occurs.

17.12.s:
pātālamārgā bahavaḥ svargamārgaśca dṛśyate ..
gagane dṛśyate sūryo hṛdaye dṛśyate haraḥ .. 39 ..
17.12.d:
पातालमार्गा बहवः स्वर्गमार्गश्च दृश्यते ..
गगने दृश्यते सूर्यो हृदये दृश्यते हरः .. 39 ..
17.12.m: Many are the paths to Pātāla, and the path to heaven is seen; / in the sky the sun is seen, in the heart Hara is seen.

17.12.s:
dhyānena jñānayogena tapasā vacasā guroḥ ..
satyena sāhasenaiva dṛśyate bhuvanatrayam .. 7.2.12.40 ..
17.12.d:
ध्यानेन ज्ञानयोगेन तपसा वचसा गुरोः ..
सत्येन साहसेनैव दृश्यते भुवनत्रयम् .. 7.2.12.40 ..
17.12.m: Through meditation, the yoga of knowledge, austerity, the words of the guru, / through truth, and through sheer courage, the three worlds are perceived.

17.12.s:
vedasmṛtipurāṇaiśca ye na paśyaṃti bhūtalam ..
pātālaṃ svargalokaṃ ca vaṃcitāste narā iha .. 41 ..
17.12.d:
वेदस्मृतिपुराणैश्च ये न पश्यंति भूतलम् ..
पातालं स्वर्गलोकं च वंचितास्ते नरा इह .. 41 ..
17.12.m: Those who do not see the surface of the earth, / Pātāla, and the heavenly world through the Vedas, the Smṛtis, and the Purāṇas, are deceived men in this world.

17.12.s:
ye virajyaṃti na strīṣu kāmāsaktā vicetasaḥ ..
dehonyathā varastrīṇāmanyathā taiśca ciṃtitam .. 42 ..
17.12.d:
ये विरज्यंति न स्त्रीषु कामासक्ता विचेतसः ..
देहोन्यथा वरस्त्रीणामन्यथा तैश्च चिंतितम् .. 42 ..
17.12.m: Those who do not turn away from women, attached to desire, devoid of reason— / the body of beautiful women is one thing, and it was conceived differently by them.

17.12.s:
janmabhūmiṣu te raktā janyaṃte jaṃtavaḥ punaḥ ..
muktimārgātpunarbhraṣṭā jāyaṃte paśuyoniṣu .. 43 ..
17.12.d:
जन्मभूमिषु ते रक्ता जन्यंते जंतवः पुनः ..
मुक्तिमार्गात्पुनर्भ्रष्टा जायंते पशुयोनिषु .. 43 ..
17.12.m: Those creatures, attached to their birthplaces, are born again; / fallen again from the path of liberation, they are born into animal wombs.

17.12.s:
dhanāni saṃprāpya varāṭikāṃ ye dvijātimukhyāya vidhāya pūjām ..
yacchaṃti no nirmalacetanā ye narādhamā daivahatā mṛtāste .. 44 ..
17.12.d:
धनानि संप्राप्य वराटिकां ये द्विजातिमुख्याय विधाय पूजाम् ..
यच्छंति नो निर्मलचेतना ये नराधमा दैवहता मृतास्ते .. 44 ..
17.12.m: Those who, having acquired wealth, do not offer even a cowrie to the foremost of the twice-born after performing worship, / those vile men of tainted thought, struck by fate, are as good as dead.

17.12.s:
dehaṃ supuṣṭaṃ vijaraṃ ca yauvanaṃ labdhvā na gaṃgādiṣu yāṃti ye narāḥ ..
mātā pitā no na suto na bāṃdhavo bhāryā svasā no duhitā na vidyate .. 45 ..
17.12.d:
देहं सुपुष्टं विजरं च यौवनं लब्ध्वा न गंगादिषु यांति ये नराः ..
माता पिता नो न सुतो न बांधवो भार्या स्वसा नो दुहिता न विद्यते .. 45 ..
17.12.m: Those men who, having obtained a well-nourished body and youth free from old age, do not go to the Gaṅgā and other [places]— / there is no mother, no father, no son, no kinsman, no wife, no sister, no daughter [who goes with them].

17.12.s:
ekastu yo yāti kathaṃ na kliśyate mūrkho na jānāti bhavaṃ maheśvaram ..
snātvā na paśyaṃti haraṃ maheśvaraṃ daivena te vai muṣitā narādhamāḥ .. 46 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye yātrā vidhivarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 12 ..
17.12.d:
एकस्तु यो याति कथं न क्लिश्यते मूर्खो न जानाति भवं महेश्वरम् ..
स्नात्वा न पश्यंति हरं महेश्वरं दैवेन ते वै मुषिता नराधमाः .. 46 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे द्वितीये वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये यात्रा विधिवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोऽध्यायः .. 12 ..
17.12.m:
How can one who goes alone not suffer? The fool does not know Bhava, the great Lord. / Having bathed, they do not behold Hara, the great Lord; those vile men are indeed robbed by fate.
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Rules of Pilgrimage', in the Glorification of the Sacred Field of Vastrāpatha, in the second [sub-section] of the seventh [part], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

17.13.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
chittvā śubhāśubhaṃ karma muktimicchecchivāṃ tataḥ ..
idaṃ na śakyate karttuṃ śubhaṃ kāryaṃ tadā naraiḥ .. 1 ..
17.13.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
छित्त्वा शुभाशुभं कर्म मुक्तिमिच्छेच्छिवां ततः ..
इदं न शक्यते कर्त्तुं शुभं कार्यं तदा नरैः .. 1 ..
17.13.m: Sārasvata said: / Having cut through good and evil karma, one should then desire auspicious liberation. / If this cannot be done, then auspicious action must be performed by men.

17.13.s:
utthāyotthāya snātavyaṃ pūjyau hariharau svayam ..
satyaṃ vācyaṃ hitaṃ kāryaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ .. 2 ..
17.13.d:
उत्थायोत्थाय स्नातव्यं पूज्यौ हरिहरौ स्वयम् ..
सत्यं वाच्यं हितं कार्यं दानं देयं स्वशक्तितः .. 2 ..
17.13.m: Rising again and again, one must bathe; Hari and Hara must be worshipped by oneself; / truth must be spoken, beneficial deeds must be done, and gifts must be given according to one's capacity.

17.13.s:
parāpavādabhīrutvaṃ paradārānvivarjayet ..
suvarṇabhūmiharaṇabrahmadevasvavarjanam .. 3 ..
17.13.d:
परापवादभीरुत्वं परदारान्विवर्जयेत् ..
सुवर्णभूमिहरणब्रह्मदेवस्ववर्जनम् .. 3 ..
17.13.m: One should fear the censure of others and avoid other men's wives, / and avoid the seizure of gold, land, and the property of brahmins and gods. // 3

17.13.s:
brāhmaṇastrīnareṃdrāṇāṃ bālavṛddhatapasvinām ..
pitṛmātṛgurūṇāṃ ca nāpriyaṃ manasā vadet .. 4 ..
17.13.d:
ब्राह्मणस्त्रीनरेंद्राणां बालवृद्धतपस्विनाम् ..
पितृमातृगुरूणां च नाप्रियं मनसा वदेत् .. 4 ..
17.13.m: Toward brahmins, women, kings, children, the elderly, and ascetics, / and toward one's father, mother, and teachers, one should not even mentally say anything displeasing. // 4

17.13.s:
deśakālaparijñānaṃ pātrāpātravivecanam ..
chāyā nṛṇāṃ na vaktavyā takrāgnīṃdhanakāṃjikam ..5..
17.13.d:
देशकालपरिज्ञानं पात्रापात्रविवेचनम् ..
छाया नृणां न वक्तव्या तक्राग्नींधनकांजिकम् ..5..
17.13.m: Understanding place and time, distinguishing worthy and unworthy recipients; / the shadow of men should not be spoken of, [nor denied] buttermilk, fire, fuel, sour gruel, // 5

17.13.s:
auṣadhaṃ śākamarthibhyo dātavyaṃ gṛha medhibhiḥ ..
ekādaśīpaṃcadaśīcaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca .. 6 ..
17.13.d:
औषधं शाकमर्थिभ्यो दातव्यं गृह मेधिभिः ..
एकादशीपंचदशीचतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च .. 6 ..
17.13.m: medicine, and vegetables—these should be given to supplicants by householders. / On the eleventh, fifteenth, fourteenth, and eighth days, // 6

17.13.s:
amāvāsyāvyatīpātasaṃkrāṃtigrahaṇeṣu ca ..
vaidhṛte pitṛmātrośca kṣayāhadivaseṣu ca .. 7 ..
17.13.d:
अमावास्याव्यतीपातसंक्रांतिग्रहणेषु च ..
वैधृते पितृमात्रोश्च क्षयाहदिवसेषु च .. 7 ..
17.13.m: and on the new moon, vyatīpāta, transit of the sun, eclipses, / vaidhṛti, and on the anniversary of the death of father and mother, // 7

17.13.s:
yugādimanvādidine gṛhe kāryo mahotsavaḥ ..
tīrthe vā gamanaṃ kāryaṃ gṛhācchataguṇaṃ yataḥ .. 8 ..
17.13.d:
युगादिमन्वादिदिने गृहे कार्यो महोत्सवः ..
तीर्थे वा गमनं कार्यं गृहाच्छतगुणं यतः .. 8 ..
17.13.m: and on the day of the beginning of a yuga or the beginning of a manvantara, a great festival is to be held in the home, / or a journey should be made to a sacred ford, since it bears a hundred times more fruit than at home. // 8

17.13.s:
idriyāṇāṃ jayaḥ kāryo madyaṃ dyūtaṃ vivarjayet ..
vivādaṃ gamanaṃ yuddhaṃ gṛhī yatnena varjayet .. 9 ..
17.13.d:
इद्रियाणां जयः कार्यो मद्यं द्यूतं विवर्जयेत् ..
विवादं गमनं युद्धं गृही यत्नेन वर्जयेत् .. 9 ..
17.13.m: Conquest of the senses must be practiced; one should renounce liquor and gambling. / A householder should diligently avoid dispute, wanderings, and fighting. // 9

17.13.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homo devapūjā dvijārcanam ..
akṣayaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ vidhivaccedbhavetkṛtam .. 7.2.13.10 ..
17.13.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमो देवपूजा द्विजार्चनम् ..
अक्षयं जायते सर्वं विधिवच्चेद्भवेत्कृतम् .. 7.2.13.10 ..
17.13.m: Ritual ablution, gifts, muttered prayer, oblation in fire, worship of the gods, and reverence to twice-borns— / all this becomes imperishable if performed according to the rules. // 7.2.13.10

17.13.s:
ekāpi gauḥ pradātavyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇā ..
dogdhrī savatsā taruṇī dvijamukhyāya kalpitā .. 11 ..
17.13.d:
एकापि गौः प्रदातव्या वस्त्रालंकारभूषणा ..
दोग्ध्री सवत्सा तरुणी द्विजमुख्याय कल्पिता .. 11 ..
17.13.m: Even a single cow should be given away, adorned with garments and ornaments, / a milch cow, with her calf, young, dedicated to an eminent twice-born. // 11

17.13.s:
saṃprāpya bhārataṃ khaṃḍaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma cottamam ..
dhanyo dadāti yo dhenuṃ sa naraḥ sūryamaṇḍalam..
bhittvā yāti vimānena gamyamāno gavādibhiḥ ..12..
17.13.d:
संप्राप्य भारतं खंडं मानुषं जन्म चोत्तमम् ..
धन्यो ददाति यो धेनुं स नरः सूर्यमण्डलम्..
भित्त्वा याति विमानेन गम्यमानो गवादिभिः ..12..
17.13.m: Having attained the land of Bhārata and an excellent human birth, / blessed is he who gives a cow: that man, piercing the solar disc, / goes in an aerial chariot, accompanied by cows and others. // 12

17.13.s:
sapta janmāni pāpāni kṛtvā pāpīha cādhamaḥ..
eko dadāti yo dhenuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 13 ..
17.13.d:
सप्त जन्मानि पापानि कृत्वा पापीह चाधमः..
एको ददाति यो धेनुं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 13 ..
17.13.m: Even a sinner and vile man here who has committed sins for seven births, / if he alone gives a cow, is freed from all sins. // 13

17.13.s:
yadā sa nīyate baddho yamamārgeṇa kiṃkaraiḥ ..
tadā naṃdā samāgatya svaṃ putramiva paśyati .. 14 ..
17.13.d:
यदा स नीयते बद्धो यममार्गेण किंकरैः ..
तदा नंदा समागत्य स्वं पुत्रमिव पश्यति .. 14 ..
17.13.m: When, bound, he is led along the path of Yama by the messengers, / then Nandā arrives and looks upon him as her own son. // 14

17.13.s:
vijitya huṃkṛtenaiva tāndūtāndūrataḥ sthitān ..
gopradaṃ taṃ samādāya prayāti śivamandiram ..15..
17.13.d:
विजित्य हुंकृतेनैव तान्दूतान्दूरतः स्थितान् ..
गोप्रदं तं समादाय प्रयाति शिवमन्दिरम् ..15..
17.13.m: Overcoming those messengers standing at a distance with merely a bellow, / she takes that giver of a cow and goes to the abode of Śiva. // 15

17.13.s:
vṛṣo dharma hati prokto yena muktaḥ sa mucyate ..
goṣu madhye pitṝnsarvānharamuddiśya vā harim ..16..
17.13.d:
वृषो धर्म हति प्रोक्तो येन मुक्तः स मुच्यते ..
गोषु मध्ये पितॄन्सर्वान्हरमुद्दिश्य वा हरिम् ..16..
17.13.m: The bull is said to be Dharma itself; he who releases it is freed. / Among cows, [dedicating them] to all the ancestors, or for the sake of Hara or Hari, // 16

17.13.s:
sūryabrahmapure vāso jāyate brahmavāsare ..
dṛḍhaṃ kakudminaṃ saṃtaṃ yuvānaṃ bhārasādhanam ..17..
17.13.d:
सूर्यब्रह्मपुरे वासो जायते ब्रह्मवासरे ..
दृढं ककुद्मिनं संतं युवानं भारसाधनम् ..17..
17.13.m: a dwelling is obtained in the city of the Sun or of Brahmā for a day of Brahmā. / Giving to a brahmin on festival days a sturdy, humped, // 17

17.13.s:
halakṣamaṃ balīvardaṃ dattvā viprāya parvasu ..
tamāruhya naro yāti golokaṃ śivasaṃnidhau .. 18 ..
17.13.d:
हलक्षमं बलीवर्दं दत्त्वा विप्राय पर्वसु ..
तमारुह्य नरो याति गोलोकं शिवसंनिधौ .. 18 ..
17.13.m: virtuous, youthful ox, capable of carrying loads and fit for the plow, / that man mounts him and goes to Goloka in the presence of Śiva. // 18

17.13.s:
aśvaṃ sāstaraṇaṃ dattvā khalīnena ca saṃyutam ..
aśvarājabalātsvarge modate brāhmavāsaram .. 19 ..
17.13.d:
अश्वं सास्तरणं दत्त्वा खलीनेन च संयुतम् ..
अश्वराजबलात्स्वर्गे मोदते ब्राह्मवासरम् .. 19 ..
17.13.m: Giving a horse equipped with a saddle cloth and provided with a bridle, / he rejoices in heaven for a day of Brahmā through the power of the king of horses. // 19

17.13.s:
gajadānādgajeṃdreṇa nīyate naṃdanaṃ vanam ..
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāṃtāyāmeṣa rājā bhaviṣyati ..7.2.13.20..
17.13.d:
गजदानाद्गजेंद्रेण नीयते नंदनं वनम् ..
पृथिव्यां सागरांतायामेष राजा भविष्यति ..7.2.13.20..
17.13.m: From the gift of an elephant, he is led to the Nandana grove by the lord of elephants; / he will become a king on the earth bordered by the ocean. // 7.2.13.20

17.13.s:
gṛhaṃ sopaskaraṃ dattvā viprāya gṛhamedhine ..
labhate naṃdane divyaṃ vimānaṃ sārvakāmikam .. 21 ..
17.13.d:
गृहं सोपस्करं दत्त्वा विप्राय गृहमेधिने ..
लभते नंदने दिव्यं विमानं सार्वकामिकम् .. 21 ..
17.13.m: Giving a house with furnishings to a brahmin householder, / he obtains a celestial aerial chariot in Nandana that grants all desires. // 21

17.13.s:
dravyaṃ pṛthivyāṃ paramaṃ suvarṇaṃ hṛṣyaṃti devā yadi dīyate tataḥ ..
sūryopi tasmai ruciraṃ vimānaṃ dadāti tāvadbhramate'tra yāvat ..22..
17.13.d:
द्रव्यं पृथिव्यां परमं सुवर्णं हृष्यंति देवा यदि दीयते ततः ..
सूर्योपि तस्मै रुचिरं विमानं ददाति तावद्भ्रमतेऽत्र यावत् ..22..
17.13.m: Gold is the supreme substance on earth; if it is given, then the gods rejoice; / the Sun also grants him a radiant aerial chariot, wandering here as long as [the Sun] moves. // 22

17.13.s:
raupyaṃ pitṝṇāmativallabhaṃ taddattvā naro nirmalatāmupaiti ..
somasya lokaṃ labhate sa tāvadbhuve nivaddhā ṛṣayo hi yāvat .. 23 ..
17.13.d:
रौप्यं पितॄणामतिवल्लभं तद्दत्त्वा नरो निर्मलतामुपैति ..
सोमस्य लोकं लभते स तावद्भुवे निवद्धा ऋषयो हि यावत् .. 23 ..
17.13.m: Silver is exceedingly dear to the ancestors; by giving it, a man attains purity; / he obtains the world of Soma for as long as the seers remain fixed to the earth. // 23

17.13.s:
śrīkhaṃḍakarpūrasamākulāni tāṃbūlaratnādiphalāni dattvā ..
puṣpāṇi vastrāṇi sukhena yāti sākaṃ śaśāṃkaṃ divi devavṛṃdaiḥ .. .. 24 ..
17.13.d:
श्रीखंडकर्पूरसमाकुलानि तांबूलरत्नादिफलानि दत्त्वा ..
पुष्पाणि वस्त्राणि सुखेन याति साकं शशांकं दिवि देववृंदैः .. .. 24 ..
17.13.m: Having given betel leaves accompanied by sandalwood and camphor, gems, and fruits, / flowers, and garments, he happily goes to the Moon in heaven with multitudes of gods. // 24

17.13.s:
takrodakatailaghṛtadugdhekṣurasamadhūni yo dadyāt ..
kharjūrakhaṃḍadrākṣāvātāmāṃjīrakaiḥ sākam .. 25 ..
17.13.d:
तक्रोदकतैलघृतदुग्धेक्षुरसमधूनि यो दद्यात् ..
खर्जूरखंडद्राक्षावातामांजीरकैः साकम् .. 25 ..
17.13.m: He who gives buttermilk, water, oil, clarified butter, milk, sugarcane juice, and honey, / together with dates, sugar candy, grapes, almonds, and figs; // 25

17.13.s:
darbhākṣatamṛdgomayadūrvāyajñopavītāni ..
tilacarmasūryapiṭakaṃ dattvā khyātaściraṃ svarge .. 26 ..
17.13.d:
दर्भाक्षतमृद्गोमयदूर्वायज्ञोपवीतानि ..
तिलचर्मसूर्यपिटकं दत्त्वा ख्यातश्चिरं स्वर्गे .. 26 ..
17.13.m: having given darbha grass, unbroken grains, clay, cow dung, dūrvā grass, sacred threads, / sesame, hide, and a solar basket, he becomes famous for a long time in heaven. // 26

17.13.s:
ātmāhārāccaturbhāgaṃ siddhānnādyadi dīyate ..
hantakāraḥ sa taṃ dattvā dhruvaṃ yāti dhruvālaye .. .. 27 ..
17.13.d:
आत्माहाराच्चतुर्भागं सिद्धान्नाद्यदि दीयते ..
हन्तकारः स तं दत्त्वा ध्रुवं याति ध्रुवालये .. .. 27 ..
17.13.m: If a fourth part of cooked food from one's own meal is given, / that is the hantakāra offering; having given it, he goes surely to the abode of Dhruva. // 27

17.13.s:
ātmāhārapramāṇena pratyahaṃ goṣu dīyate ..
gavāhnikaṃ tāsu dattvā naro yāti surālayam .. 28 ..
17.13.d:
आत्माहारप्रमाणेन प्रत्यहं गोषु दीयते ..
गवाह्निकं तासु दत्त्वा नरो याति सुरालयम् .. 28 ..
17.13.m: If a daily portion is given to cows measured to one's own meal, / having given that daily feed to them, a man goes to the abode of the gods. // 28

17.13.s:
kaṃḍanīpeṣaṇīcullīmārjanībhiśca yatkṛtam ..
pāpaṃ gṛhī kṣālayati dadadbhikṣāṃ dinaṃ prati .. 29 ..
17.13.d:
कंडनीपेषणीचुल्लीमार्जनीभिश्च यत्कृतम् ..
पापं गृही क्षालयति ददद्भिक्षां दिनं प्रति .. 29 ..
17.13.m: The sin committed by the mortar, the grinding stone, the hearth, and the broom— / the householder washes away by giving alms every day. // 29

17.13.s:
grāsamātrā bhavedbhikṣā sā nityaṃ yatra dīyate ..
tadgṛhaṃ gṛhamanyacca smaśānamiva dṛśyate .. 7.2.13.30 ..
17.13.d:
ग्रासमात्रा भवेद्भिक्षा सा नित्यं यत्र दीयते ..
तद्गृहं गृहमन्यच्च स्मशानमिव दृश्यते .. 7.2.13.30 ..
17.13.m: Alms should be the size of a single morsel; where that is given daily, / that house is truly a home; any other appears like a cremation ground. // 7.2.13.30

17.13.s:
kumbhānsodakasiddhānnāṃśchatropānatkamaṃḍalum ..
aṃgulīyakavāsāṃsi dattvā yāti naro divi .. 31 ..
17.13.d:
कुम्भान्सोदकसिद्धान्नांश्छत्रोपानत्कमंडलुम् ..
अंगुलीयकवासांसि दत्त्वा याति नरो दिवि .. 31 ..
17.13.m: Having given water-jars filled with water and cooked food, an umbrella, shoes, and a water-pot, / rings and clothes, a man goes to heaven. // 31

17.13.s:
śrāṃtasya yānaṃ tṛṣitasya pānamannaṃ kṣudhārttasya naro narendra ..
dattvā vimānena surāṃganābhiḥ saṃstūyamānastridivaṃ sa yāti .. 32 ..
17.13.d:
श्रांतस्य यानं तृषितस्य पानमन्नं क्षुधार्त्तस्य नरो नरेन्द्र ..
दत्त्वा विमानेन सुरांगनाभिः संस्तूयमानस्त्रिदिवं स याति .. 32 ..
17.13.m: Giving a conveyance to the weary, drink to the thirsty, and food to the hungry, O king, / praised by celestial maidens, that man goes to heaven in an aerial chariot. // 32

17.13.s:
bhojanaṃ satataṃ deyaṃ yathāśaktyā ghṛta plutam ..
tanmayā hi yataḥ prāṇā ataḥ puṣyaṃti prāṇinaḥ .. 33 ..
17.13.d:
भोजनं सततं देयं यथाशक्त्या घृत प्लुतम् ..
तन्मया हि यतः प्राणा अतः पुष्यंति प्राणिनः .. 33 ..
17.13.m: Food steeped in clarified butter should be given constantly according to one's means, / for the vital breaths consist of it; therefore living beings are nourished. // 33

17.13.s:
kṣutpīḍā mahatī loke hyannaṃ tadbheṣajaṃ smṛtam ..
tena sā śāṃtimāyāti tatonnaṃ deyamuttamam .. 34 ..
17.13.d:
क्षुत्पीडा महती लोके ह्यन्नं तद्भेषजं स्मृतम् ..
तेन सा शांतिमायाति ततोन्नं देयमुत्तमम् .. 34 ..
17.13.m: The torment of hunger is great in the world, and food is remembered as its medicine; / by it, that [torment] comes to peace; therefore excellent food should be given. // 34

17.13.s:
annaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ takraṃ śākaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu ..
patraṃ puṣpaṃ tathopānatkaṃthāṃ yaṣṭiṃ kamaṃḍalum .. 35 ..
17.13.d:
अन्नं वस्त्रं फलं तोयं तक्रं शाकं घृतं मधु ..
पत्रं पुष्पं तथोपानत्कंथां यष्टिं कमंडलुम् .. 35 ..
17.13.m: Food, clothing, fruit, water, buttermilk, vegetables, clarified butter, honey, / leaves, flowers, likewise shoes, a patched garment, a staff, a water-pot, // 35

17.13.s:
chatrapātre vrataṃ vidyā akṣamālā surārcanam ..
kanyā kuśopavītāni bījauṣadhagṛhāṇi ca .. 36 ..
17.13.d:
छत्रपात्रे व्रतं विद्या अक्षमाला सुरार्चनम् ..
कन्या कुशोपवीतानि बीजौषधगृहाणि च .. 36 ..
17.13.m: an umbrella, a vessel, a vow, knowledge, a rosary, worship of the gods, / a maiden, kuśa grass, sacred threads, seeds, medicines, and houses, // 36

17.13.s:
sasyaṃ kṣetraṃ yajñapātraṃ yogapaṭṭaṃ ca pāduke ..
kṛṣṇājinaṃ buddhidānaṃ dharmādeśakathānakam .. 37 ..
17.13.d:
सस्यं क्षेत्रं यज्ञपात्रं योगपट्टं च पादुके ..
कृष्णाजिनं बुद्धिदानं धर्मादेशकथानकम् .. 37 ..
17.13.m: crops, a field, a sacrificial vessel, an ascetic's strap, sandals, / a black antelope skin, the gift of wisdom, and discourse explaining Dharma— // 37

17.13.s:
athaitatsaṃtataṃ deyaṃ tena śreyo mahadbhavet ..
sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā dātā yāti śivālayam .. 38 ..
17.13.d:
अथैतत्संततं देयं तेन श्रेयो महद्भवेत् ..
सर्वपापक्षयं कृत्वा दाता याति शिवालयम् .. 38 ..
17.13.m: these should now be constantly given; thereby great welfare ensues. / Having destroyed all sins, the giver goes to the abode of Śiva. // 38

17.13.s:
śrāddhe gṛhasthā bhoktavyāḥ kulīnā vedapāragāḥ ..
akrodhanāḥ snānaśīlāḥ svadeśācāratatparāḥ .. 39 ..
17.13.d:
श्राद्धे गृहस्था भोक्तव्याः कुलीना वेदपारगाः ..
अक्रोधनाः स्नानशीलाः स्वदेशाचारतत्पराः .. 39 ..
17.13.m: At a śrāddha, householders of noble birth who have mastered the Vedas should be fed, / free from anger, devoted to ritual ablution, dedicated to the customs of their own country, // 39

17.13.s:
āmaṃtrya pūrvadivase nirīhā api ye dvijāḥ ..
alolupā vyādhihīnā na tu ye grāmayājinaḥ .. 7.2.13.40 ..
17.13.d:
आमंत्र्य पूर्वदिवसे निरीहा अपि ये द्विजाः ..
अलोलुपा व्याधिहीना न तु ये ग्रामयाजिनः .. 7.2.13.40 ..
17.13.m: twice-borns who, having been invited the day before, are desireless, / free from greed and illness, but not those who sacrifice for an entire village. // 7.2.13.40

17.13.s:
teṣāṃ puraḥ pradātavyaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ śraddhāvihīnena kṛtamapyakṛtaṃ bhavet .. 41 ..
17.13.d:
तेषां पुरः प्रदातव्यं पिंडदानं विधानतः ..
श्राद्धं श्रद्धाविहीनेन कृतमप्यकृतं भवेत् .. 41 ..
17.13.m: In front of them, the offering of rice-balls must be given according to the rules. / A śrāddha performed without faith becomes as if not done at all. // 41

17.13.s:
tasmācchraddhānvitaiḥ śrāddhaṃ karttavyaṃ krodhavarjitaiḥ ..
vānaprastho brahmacārī pathikastīrthasevakaḥ .. 42 ..
17.13.d:
तस्माच्छ्रद्धान्वितैः श्राद्धं कर्त्तव्यं क्रोधवर्जितैः ..
वानप्रस्थो ब्रह्मचारी पथिकस्तीर्थसेवकः .. 42 ..
17.13.m: Therefore, a śrāddha must be performed with faith and free from anger. / A forest-dweller, a celibate student, a traveler, one who serves sacred fords, // 42

17.13.s:
atithirvaiśvadevāṃte sa pūjyaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ..
sarvadā yatayaḥ pūjyāḥ svaśaktyā gṛhamedhibhiḥ .. 43 ..
17.13.d:
अतिथिर्वैश्वदेवांते स पूज्यः श्राद्धकर्मणि ..
सर्वदा यतयः पूज्याः स्वशक्त्या गृहमेधिभिः .. 43 ..
17.13.m: [or] a guest at the end of the vaiśvadeva rite should be honored at a śrāddha ceremony; / ascetics should always be honored by householders according to their capacity. // 43

17.13.s:
yātrāvidhimatho vakṣye setihāsaṃ nṛpottama .. 44 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye tīrthayātrāvidhivarṇane śrāddhadānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 13 ..
17.13.d:
यात्राविधिमथो वक्ष्ये सेतिहासं नृपोत्तम .. 44 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे द्वितीये वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये तीर्थयात्राविधिवर्णने श्राद्धदानादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः .. .. 13 ..
17.13.m:
Next I will explain the procedure for pilgrimage along with historical accounts, O best of kings. // 44
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of Śrāddha, Gifts, and Other Rites in the Exposition of the Rules for Pilgrimage,” in the second part, the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

17.14.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
vastrāpathe mahākṣetre nagare vāmane purā ..
putraśokābhisaṃtapto vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ .. 1 ..
17.14.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
वस्त्रापथे महाक्षेत्रे नगरे वामने पुरा ..
पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तो वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः .. 1 ..
17.14.m: Sārasvata said: / Formerly, in the Vastrāpatha, that great sacred field, in the city of Vāmana, / the venerable seer Vasiṣṭha was consumed by grief for his sons.

17.14.s:
ājagāma tapastaptuṃ svarṇarekhānadītaṭe ..
īśānakoṇe nagarātsvarṇarekhānadījale .. 2 ..
17.14.d:
आजगाम तपस्तप्तुं स्वर्णरेखानदीतटे ..
ईशानकोणे नगरात्स्वर्णरेखानदीजले .. 2 ..
17.14.m: He came to perform austerities on the bank of the Svarṇarekhā River. / In the northeast direction from the city, in the waters of the Svarṇarekhā River,

17.14.s:
snātvā dhyātvā śivaṃ devaṃ manasā'cintayadyadā ..
tadā rudraḥ samāyātastrinetro vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
maharṣe tava tuṣṭo'haṃ kiṃ karomi vadasva tat .. 3 ..
17.14.d:
स्नात्वा ध्यात्वा शिवं देवं मनसाऽचिन्तयद्यदा ..
तदा रुद्रः समायातस्त्रिनेत्रो वृषभध्वजः ..
महर्षे तव तुष्टोऽहं किं करोमि वदस्व तत् .. 3 ..
17.14.m: having bathed and meditated on God Śiva, when he contemplated him in his mind, / then Rudra arrived, the three-eyed god whose banner bears a bull: / “Great seer, I am pleased with you; tell me what I may do [for you].”

17.14.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva varo deyo mamādhunā ..
tadā'tra bhavatā stheyaṃ yāvadācaṃdratārakam .. 4 ..
17.14.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टो महादेव वरो देयो ममाधुना ..
तदाऽत्र भवता स्थेयं यावदाचंद्रतारकम् .. 4 ..
17.14.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / “If you are pleased, Mahādeva, and a boon is to be given to me now, / then you should remain here as long as the moon and stars endure.

17.14.s:
atra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti ye narāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ ..
teṣāṃ pāpakṣayo deva kartavyo bhavatā sadā .. 5 ..
17.14.d:
अत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति ये नराः पापकर्मिणः ..
तेषां पापक्षयो देव कर्तव्यो भवता सदा .. 5 ..
17.14.m: Whenever sinful men shall perform ritual ablutions here, / you must always effect the destruction of their sins, O God.

17.14.s:
narā ye pāpakarmāṇaḥ pūjayaṃti trilocanam ..
tānnarānnaya deveśa vimānaiḥ śivamaṃdiram .. 6 ..
17.14.d:
नरा ये पापकर्माणः पूजयंति त्रिलोचनम् ..
तान्नरान्नय देवेश विमानैः शिवमंदिरम् .. 6 ..
17.14.m: Those sinful men who worship the three-eyed god— / bring those men, O Lord of gods, to Śiva’s abode in aerial chariots!”

17.14.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
tathetyuktā haro devastatraivāṃtara dhīyata ..
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā narasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
trailokyamiṃdrāya dadau kālarudraṃ svayaṃ yayau .. 7 ..
17.14.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
तथेत्युक्ता हरो देवस्तत्रैवांतर धीयत ..
हिरण्यकशिपुं हत्वा नरसिंहो महाबलः ..
त्रैलोक्यमिंद्राय ददौ कालरुद्रं स्वयं ययौ .. 7 ..
17.14.m: Sārasvata said: / Having said, “So be it,” God Hara vanished right there. / After slaying Hiraṇyakaśipu, the mighty Narasiṃha / gave the three worlds to Indra, while he himself departed to Kālarudra.

17.14.s:
tadanvaye balirjātaḥ sa cātīva balā dhikaḥ ..
ekātapatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ baliścakre balādhikaḥ ..
akṛṣṭapacyā sujalā dharitrī sasyaśālinī .. 8 ..
17.14.d:
तदन्वये बलिर्जातः स चातीव बला धिकः ..
एकातपत्रां पृथिवीं बलिश्चक्रे बलाधिकः ..
अकृष्टपच्या सुजला धरित्री सस्यशालिनी .. 8 ..
17.14.m: In his lineage was born Bali, who possessed extraordinary strength. / That exceedingly strong Bali brought the earth under a single parasol; / the earth bore crops without cultivation, had abundant water, and was rich in grain.

17.14.s:
gandhavaṃti ca puṣpāṇi rasavaṃti phalāni ca ..
āskandhaphalino vṛkṣāḥ puṭake puṭake madhu .. 9 ..
17.14.d:
गन्धवंति च पुष्पाणि रसवंति फलानि च ..
आस्कन्धफलिनो वृक्षाः पुटके पुटके मधु .. 9 ..
17.14.m: The flowers were fragrant, the fruits flavorful; / the trees bore fruit right down to their trunks, and honey filled every hollow.

17.14.s:
caturvedā dvijāḥ sarve kṣatriyā yuddhakovidāḥ ..
goṣu sevāparā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ .. .. 7.2.14.10 ..
17.14.d:
चतुर्वेदा द्विजाः सर्वे क्षत्रिया युद्धकोविदाः ..
गोषु सेवापरा वैश्याः शूद्राः शुश्रूषणे रताः .. .. 7.2.14.10 ..
17.14.m: All brahmins were masters of the four Vedas; kṣatriyas were skilled in warfare; / vaiśyas were devoted to caring for cattle; and śūdras were intent on service.

17.14.s:
sadācārā janapadā ītivyādhivivarjitāḥ ..
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāḥ sarve sadānaṃdāḥ sadodyatāḥ .. 11 ..
17.14.d:
सदाचारा जनपदा ईतिव्याधिविवर्जिताः ..
हृष्टपुष्टजनाः सर्वे सदानंदाः सदोद्यताः .. 11 ..
17.14.m: The inhabitants of the realm were virtuous in conduct, free from agricultural calamities and disease; / all the people were joyous, robust, ever happy, and ever energetic.

17.14.s:
kuṃkumāguruliptāṃgāḥ suveṣāḥ sādhumaṃḍitāḥ ..
dāridryaduḥkhamaraṇairvimuktāścirajīvinaḥ .. 12 ..
17.14.d:
कुंकुमागुरुलिप्तांगाः सुवेषाः साधुमंडिताः ..
दारिद्र्यदुःखमरणैर्विमुक्ताश्चिरजीविनः .. 12 ..
17.14.m: With their limbs smeared with saffron and agallochum, well-attired, and handsomely adorned, / they were freed from poverty, grief, and premature death, living long lives.

17.14.s:
dīpoddyotitabhūbhāgā rātrāvapi yathā dine ..
vicaraṃti tathā martyā devā devālaye yathā .. .. 13 ..
17.14.d:
दीपोद्द्योतितभूभागा रात्रावपि यथा दिने ..
विचरंति तथा मर्त्या देवा देवालये यथा .. .. 13 ..
17.14.m: With regions of the earth illuminated by lamps at night just as in the day, / mortals moved about there like gods in a divine abode.

17.14.s:
pṛthivyāṃ svargarūpāyāṃ rājyaṃ cakre'suro baliḥ ..
nityaṃ vivāhavāditrairnāditaṃ bhūpamaṃdiram .. 14 ..
17.14.d:
पृथिव्यां स्वर्गरूपायां राज्यं चक्रेऽसुरो बलिः ..
नित्यं विवाहवादित्रैर्नादितं भूपमंदिरम् .. 14 ..
17.14.m: On earth turned into heaven itself, the asura Bali ruled. / The royal palace was constantly resonant with instruments played at marriages.

17.14.s:
dharitrīṃ bubhuje daityo devarājo yathā divi ..
devendro balinā nityaṃ yajñaiḥ saṃtoṣitastadā .. 15 ..
17.14.d:
धरित्रीं बुभुजे दैत्यो देवराजो यथा दिवि ..
देवेन्द्रो बलिना नित्यं यज्ञैः संतोषितस्तदा .. 15 ..
17.14.m: The daitya enjoyed the earth just as the king of gods does heaven; / at that time, Devendra was constantly gratified by Bali through sacrifices.

17.14.s:
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca nāsti yuddhaṃ parasparam ..
eka eva mahīpālo yuddhaṃ nāsti dharātale .. 16 ..
17.14.d:
देवानां दानवानां च नास्ति युद्धं परस्परम् ..
एक एव महीपालो युद्धं नास्ति धरातले .. 16 ..
17.14.m: There was no fighting between the gods and the dānavas; / there was only one king, and there was no battle upon the surface of the earth.

17.14.s:
sapatnakakalirnāma nāsti yuddhaṃ harergajaiḥ ..
na sarppanakulairnityaṃ na biḍālaiśca mūṣakaiḥ .. 17 ..
17.14.d:
सपत्नककलिर्नाम नास्ति युद्धं हरेर्गजैः ..
न सर्प्पनकुलैर्नित्यं न बिडालैश्च मूषकैः .. 17 ..
17.14.m: There was no strife among rivals; there was no fight between lions and elephants, / nor between snakes and mongooses, nor between cats and mice.

17.14.s:
maitrībhāvaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvara jaṃgamam ..
trailokyabhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā nārado naṃdane vane .. 18 ..
17.14.d:
मैत्रीभावं गतं सर्वं जगत्स्थावर जंगमम् ..
त्रैलोक्यभ्रमणं कृत्वा नारदो नंदने वने .. 18 ..
17.14.m: The entire world, moving and unmoving, attained a state of friendship. / Having wandered through the three worlds, Nārada, in the Nandana grove,

17.14.s:
gato na paśyate yuddhaṃ trailokye sacarācare ..
tāvattasyodare pīḍā mahatī samajāyata .. 19 ..
17.14.d:
गतो न पश्यते युद्धं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..
तावत्तस्योदरे पीडा महती समजायत .. 19 ..
17.14.m: went about and saw no battle in the three worlds, with all that moves and is still; / then a great ache arose in his stomach:

17.14.s:
na me snānādinā kāryaṃ tarppaṇaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ..
japahomādinā sarvamanyathā mama ceṣṭitam .. 7.2.14.20 ..
17.14.d:
न मे स्नानादिना कार्यं तर्प्पणैः किं प्रयोजनम् ..
जपहोमादिना सर्वमन्यथा मम चेष्टितम् .. 7.2.14.20 ..
17.14.m: “I have no business with ritual ablutions and the like; what purpose have I with oblations? / My actions are otherwise turned away from all recitation, fire-offerings, and the like.

17.14.s:
tatsnānaṃ yatra yudhyante gajā daṃtavighaṭṭanaiḥ ..
sā saṃdhyā yatra nihataiḥ kabandhairbhūrvibhūṣitā .. 21 ..
17.14.d:
तत्स्नानं यत्र युध्यन्ते गजा दंतविघट्टनैः ..
सा संध्या यत्र निहतैः कबन्धैर्भूर्विभूषिता .. 21 ..
17.14.m: That is a [true] bath where elephants fight, clashing their tusks; / that is [true] twilight worship where the earth is adorned with headless torsos of the slain;

17.14.s:
kuṃtaghātavinirbhinnagajakumbhodbhavāsṛjā ..
tṛpyaṃti yatra kravyādāstarpaṇaṃ tanmama priyam .. 22 ..
17.14.d:
कुंतघातविनिर्भिन्नगजकुम्भोद्भवासृजा ..
तृप्यंति यत्र क्रव्यादास्तर्पणं तन्मम प्रियम् .. 22 ..
17.14.m: where carnivores are sated with the blood flowing from the frontal lobes of elephants shattered by blows of spears— / that oblation is dear to me.

17.14.s:
gajaśīrṣairagamyāste nihatāḥ kṣatriyā raṇe ..
sa homo yatra hūyaṃte gajāśca narapuṃgavāḥ .. 23 ..
17.14.d:
गजशीर्षैरगम्यास्ते निहताः क्षत्रिया रणे ..
स होमो यत्र हूयंते गजाश्च नरपुंगवाः .. 23 ..
17.14.m: Those kṣatriyas slain in battle are an inaccessible forest of elephant-heads; / that is a [true] fire-offering where elephants and foremost among men are offered as oblations.

17.14.s:
śabdāgnau nāradasyāyaṃ homastrai lokyaviśrutaḥ ..
chinnapādaśirohastairaṃtarāṃtravilabitaiḥ .. 24 ..
17.14.d:
शब्दाग्नौ नारदस्यायं होमस्त्रै लोक्यविश्रुतः ..
छिन्नपादशिरोहस्तैरंतरांत्रविलबितैः .. 24 ..
17.14.m: This is Nārada’s offering in the fire of battle-cries, famed throughout the three worlds! / When the surface of the earth is adorned with severed feet, heads, and hands,

17.14.s:
yadarcyate bhūmitalaṃ tanme nityaṃ surārcanam ..
kiṃ devairdivi me kāryaṃ kiṃ manuṣyairdharātale .. 25 ..
17.14.d:
यदर्च्यते भूमितलं तन्मे नित्यं सुरार्चनम् ..
किं देवैर्दिवि मे कार्यं किं मनुष्यैर्धरातले .. 25 ..
17.14.m: and hung with entrails, that is my constant worship of the gods! / What have I to do with gods in heaven, or with men on the earth,

17.14.s:
pannagaiḥ kiṃ tu pātāle na yudhyante parasparam ..
tathā kariṣye devendrādupendrācca dharātale .. 26 ..
17.14.d:
पन्नगैः किं तु पाताले न युध्यन्ते परस्परम् ..
तथा करिष्ये देवेन्द्रादुपेन्द्राच्च धरातले .. 26 ..
17.14.m: or with serpents in Pātāla, if they do not fight one another? / I will act in such a way, through Devendra and Upendra on the earth,

17.14.s:
rasātalaṃ baliryātu satyamastu vaco mama ..
jīvitenāpi rājyena yadā dāmodaraṃ harim .. 27 ..
17.14.d:
रसातलं बलिर्यातु सत्यमस्तु वचो मम ..
जीवितेनापि राज्येन यदा दामोदरं हरिम् .. 27 ..
17.14.m: that Bali shall go to Rasātala; let my word prove true! / When with his very life and his kingdom [Bali]

17.14.s:
toṣayiṣyati yatnena tadendro'sau bhaviṣyati ..
devendro vṛtrahā bhūtvā bhraṣṭarājyo bhaviṣyati .. 28 ..
17.14.d:
तोषयिष्यति यत्नेन तदेन्द्रोऽसौ भविष्यति ..
देवेन्द्रो वृत्रहा भूत्वा भ्रष्टराज्यो भविष्यति .. 28 ..
17.14.m: pleases Dāmodara Hari with exertion, then he shall become Indra. / Having slain Vṛtra, Devendra will lose his sovereignty.

17.14.s:
yadā vastrāpathe gatvā bhavaṃ bhāvena pūjayet ..
surādhipastadā bhūyo brahmahatyāvivarjitaḥ .. 29 ..
17.14.d:
यदा वस्त्रापथे गत्वा भवं भावेन पूजयेत् ..
सुराधिपस्तदा भूयो ब्रह्महत्याविवर्जितः .. 29 ..
17.14.m: When he goes to Vastrāpatha and worships Bhava with devotion, / then the lord of the gods shall once more be freed from the sin of killing a brahmin.”

17.14.s:
anena mantrajāpyena sa śāṃtodarave danaḥ ..
nārado devarājasya samīpaṃ sahasā yayau .. 7.2.14.30 ..
17.14.d:
अनेन मन्त्रजाप्येन स शांतोदरवे दनः ..
नारदो देवराजस्य समीपं सहसा ययौ .. 7.2.14.30 ..
17.14.m: By reciting this mantra, his stomach ache was calmed; / Nārada went swiftly to the presence of the king of gods.

17.14.s:
siṃhāsanaṃ samāruhya nandane saṃsthito hariḥ ..
āste parivṛto deverdevarājo mahābalaḥ .. .. 31 ..
17.14.d:
सिंहासनं समारुह्य नन्दने संस्थितो हरिः ..
आस्ते परिवृतो देवेर्देवराजो महाबलः .. .. 31 ..
17.14.m: Mounting his throne, Hari was seated in Nandana; / the mighty king of gods sat surrounded by the deities,

17.14.s:
nirīkṣamāṇo nṛtyantīṃ raṃbhāṃ tāṃ surasundarīm..
āyāṃtaṃ dadṛśe devo nāradaṃ vismayānvitaḥ .. 32 ..
17.14.d:
निरीक्षमाणो नृत्यन्तीं रंभां तां सुरसुन्दरीम्..
आयांतं ददृशे देवो नारदं विस्मयान्वितः .. 32 ..
17.14.m: watching Rambhā, that celestial beauty, dancing. / Filled with wonder, the god saw Nārada arriving.

17.14.s:
aho viruddho bhagavānnārado mayi dṛśyate ..
nṛtyate kiṃ na vā nṛtye gīyate kiṃ na gīyate .. 33 ..
17.14.d:
अहो विरुद्धो भगवान्नारदो मयि दृश्यते ..
नृत्यते किं न वा नृत्ये गीयते किं न गीयते .. 33 ..
17.14.m: “Ah, the venerable Nārada appears hostile toward me! / Should there be dancing, or should I stop the dance? Should there be singing, or should singing cease?

17.14.s:
vādyatāṃ tālamānaiḥ kiṃ yāvacciṃtāparo hariḥ ..
ṛṣiḥ samāgatastāvajjalābhyukṣaṇata tparaḥ .. 34 ..
siṃhāsanaṃ parityajya samutthāyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ ..
svāgatenābhivādyātha babhāṣe nāradaṃ hariḥ .. 32 ..
17.14.d:
वाद्यतां तालमानैः किं यावच्चिंतापरो हरिः ..
ऋषिः समागतस्तावज्जलाभ्युक्षणत त्परः .. 34 ..
सिंहासनं परित्यज्य समुत्थायाग्रतः स्थितः ..
स्वागतेनाभिवाद्याथ बभाषे नारदं हरिः .. 32 ..
17.14.m:
Should musical instruments be played with beats and rhythms?” While Hari was thus lost in thought, / the sage arrived, intent on sprinkling water.
Leaving his throne, rising up, and standing before him, / Hari greeted Nārada with a welcome and addressed him:

17.14.s:
maharṣe svāgataṃ te'dya kuto vā''ga myate tvayā ..
snāne saṃdhyārcane home kuśalaṃ tava vidyate .. 36 ..
17.14.d:
महर्षे स्वागतं तेऽद्य कुतो वा'ऽग म्यते त्वया ..
स्नाने संध्यार्चने होमे कुशलं तव विद्यते .. 36 ..
17.14.m: “Welcome to you today, great seer! From where have you come? / Is all well with your ritual ablutions, twilight worship, and fire-offerings?”

17.14.s:
iti prokto vihasyātha babhāṣe nārado harim ..
yadyetajjāyate mahyaṃ kimanyena prayojanam .. 37..
17.14.d:
इति प्रोक्तो विहस्याथ बभाषे नारदो हरिम् ..
यद्येतज्जायते मह्यं किमन्येन प्रयोजनम् .. 37..
17.14.m: Addressed thus, Nārada laughed and spoke to Hari: / “If I have that, what need have I of anything else?

17.14.s:
prekṣaṇīkasya te sthānaṃ nāhaṃ paśyāmi svarpate ..
yāvadrājyaṃ balestāvattvayā me na prayojanam .. 38 ..
17.14.d:
प्रेक्षणीकस्य ते स्थानं नाहं पश्यामि स्वर्पते ..
यावद्राज्यं बलेस्तावत्त्वया मे न प्रयोजनम् .. 38 ..
17.14.m: I do not see any place worthy of your viewing, O Lord of heaven! / As long as the rule of Bali lasts, I have no business with you.

17.14.s:
ādityādyā grahāḥ sarve kāla mānena yojitāḥ ..
āhutyā plāvitā meghā varṣaṃti hṛṣitā bhuvi ..39..
17.14.d:
आदित्याद्या ग्रहाः सर्वे काल मानेन योजिताः ..
आहुत्या प्लाविता मेघा वर्षंति हृषिता भुवि ..39..
17.14.m: All the planets, beginning with the Sun, are regulated according to proper time; / drenched by sacrificial offerings, the clouds joyfully pour rain on the earth;

17.14.s: rogādimaraṇaṃ nāsti yamo dharmeṇa pīḍitaḥ ..7.2.14.40..
17.14.d: रोगादिमरणं नास्ति यमो धर्मेण पीडितः ..7.2.14.40..
17.14.m: there is no death from disease or other ills, and Yama is constrained by righteousness.”

17.14.s:
ekātapatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ bubhuje sa narādhipaḥ ..
trailokyanātheti mahānṛpeti saṃgrāmavidyākuśaleti nityam ..
trailokyalakṣmīkucakāmuketi saṃstūyate cāraṇabaṃdivṛndaiḥ .41..
17.14.d:
एकातपत्रां पृथिवीं बुभुजे स नराधिपः ..
त्रैलोक्यनाथेति महानृपेति संग्रामविद्याकुशलेति नित्यम् ..
त्रैलोक्यलक्ष्मीकुचकामुकेति संस्तूयते चारणबंदिवृन्दैः .41..
17.14.m: Under a single umbrella that king enjoyed the earth. / 'O Lord of the three worlds! O Great King! O One skilled in the art of war!' / 'O Lover of the breasts of the Fortune of the three worlds!'—thus he was constantly praised by multitudes of bards and minstrels:

17.14.s:
brahmeti kṛṣṇeti hareti bhūmāviṃdreti sūryeti dhanādhipeti ..
devārinātheti surādhipeti jegīyate cāraṇabaṃdivṛndaiḥ .. 42 ..
17.14.d:
ब्रह्मेति कृष्णेति हरेति भूमाविंद्रेति सूर्येति धनाधिपेति ..
देवारिनाथेति सुराधिपेति जेगीयते चारणबंदिवृन्दैः .. 42 ..
17.14.m: 'O Brahmā! O Kṛṣṇa! O Hara on earth! O Indra! O Sūrya! O Lord of wealth! / O Lord of the enemies of the gods! O Lord of the gods!'—thus he was sung of by multitudes of bards and minstrels.

17.14.s:
yuddhaṃ vinā daityagaṇā hasaṃti mattāḥ pramattāḥ kariṇo nadaṃti ..
rathādhirūḍhāḥ puruṣā bhramaṃti senādhipā strīṣu gṛhe ramaṃti..43..
17.14.d:
युद्धं विना दैत्यगणा हसंति मत्ताः प्रमत्ताः करिणो नदंति ..
रथाधिरूढाः पुरुषा भ्रमंति सेनाधिपा स्त्रीषु गृहे रमंति..43..
17.14.m: Even without a battle, the hosts of Daityas laugh; rutting and frenzied, the elephants trumpet; / mounting chariots, the men roam about; the army commanders take pleasure in their homes among women.

17.14.s:
yajñāgnidhūmena nabho virājate suvarṇarūpā pṛthivī virājate..
śūnyaṃ tu vedairbhuvanaṃ ca śobhate dhiṣṇyaṃ balerdairtyaigaṇaiśca śobhate .. 44 ..
17.14.d:
यज्ञाग्निधूमेन नभो विराजते सुवर्णरूपा पृथिवी विराजते..
शून्यं तु वेदैर्भुवनं च शोभते धिष्ण्यं बलेर्दैर्त्यैगणैश्च शोभते .. 44 ..
17.14.m: The sky shines with the smoke of sacrificial fires; the earth shines resplendent as gold; / but the world shines devoid of the Vedas, and the domain of Bali shines with hosts of Daityas.

17.14.s:
balirna jānāti surādhipaṃ tvāṃ surāśca sarve baliyajñabhojinaḥ ..
tvameva te'riṃ hṛdi ciṃtaya svayaṃ yuktaṃ tavedaṃ kathitaṃ mayeti .. 45 ..
17.14.d:
बलिर्न जानाति सुराधिपं त्वां सुराश्च सर्वे बलियज्ञभोजिनः ..
त्वमेव तेऽरिं हृदि चिंतय स्वयं युक्तं तवेदं कथितं मयेति .. 45 ..
17.14.m: Bali does not recognize you as the lord of the gods, and all the gods feed upon the sacrifice of Bali. / Consider yourself in your own heart who your enemy is; this that I have spoken to you is fitting.

17.14.s:
raṃbhā na rājate raṃge menakā tvāṃ na manyate ..
tilottamāpi manute balirājaṃ sureśvaram .. 46 ..
17.14.d:
रंभा न राजते रंगे मेनका त्वां न मन्यते ..
तिलोत्तमापि मनुते बलिराजं सुरेश्वरम् .. 46 ..
17.14.m: Rambhā does not shine upon the stage; Menakā does not esteem you; / even Tilottamā considers King Bali to be the lord of the gods.

17.14.s:
urvaśī caiva taṃ yāti sukeśā saha bhāṣate ..
mañjughoṣā mukhaṃ vaktraṃ kṛtvā tvāṃ na nirīkṣate .. 47 ..
17.14.d:
उर्वशी चैव तं याति सुकेशा सह भाषते ..
मञ्जुघोषा मुखं वक्त्रं कृत्वा त्वां न निरीक्षते .. 47 ..
17.14.m: Urvaśī goes to him, and Sukeśā speaks with him; / Mañjughoṣā turns her face away and does not look at you.

17.14.s:
pulomā pulakodbhedaṃ na karoti baliṃ vinā ..
paulomī purato gatvā baliṃ stauti ca maṃtharā .. 48 ..
17.14.d:
पुलोमा पुलकोद्भेदं न करोति बलिं विना ..
पौलोमी पुरतो गत्वा बलिं स्तौति च मंथरा .. 48 ..
17.14.m: Pulomā feels no thrill of delight without Bali; / Paulomī goes before Bali and languidly praises him.

17.14.s:
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva hāhā hūhūśca tuṃburuḥ ..
balirājyaṃ praśaṃsaṃti rudrasyāgre mayā śrutam .. .. 49 ..
17.14.d:
नारदः पर्वतश्चैव हाहा हूहूश्च तुंबुरुः ..
बलिराज्यं प्रशंसंति रुद्रस्याग्रे मया श्रुतम् .. .. 49 ..
17.14.m: Nārada, Parvata, Hāhā, Hūhū, and Tumburu / praise the reign of Bali in the presence of Rudra: so have I heard.

17.14.s:
ājyāhutībhiḥ santuṣṭā ṛṣayo brahmasadmani ..
brahmaṇo'gre praśaṃsaṃti tadevaṃ kathitaṃ mayā .. 7.2.14.50 ..
17.14.d:
आज्याहुतीभिः सन्तुष्टा ऋषयो ब्रह्मसद्मनि ..
ब्रह्मणोऽग्रे प्रशंसंति तदेवं कथितं मया .. 7.2.14.50 ..
17.14.m: Satisfied with offerings of clarified butter in the abode of Brahmā, the seers / praise [him] in the presence of Brahmā: thus have I told you.

17.14.s:
bṛhaspatiryadācaṣṭe na tadvācyaṃ mayā tava ..
iṃdrāṇī balinaṃ matvā baliṃ citreṣu paśyati .. 51 ..
17.14.d:
बृहस्पतिर्यदाचष्टे न तद्वाच्यं मया तव ..
इंद्राणी बलिनं मत्वा बलिं चित्रेषु पश्यति .. 51 ..
17.14.m: What Bṛhaspati said, I ought not to repeat to you: / Indrāṇī, regarding Bali as the mighty one, looks at Bali in portraits."

17.14.s:
anena vākyena surādhipastu cacāla kopāvaritastadānīm ..
gajeti vajreti jagāda sūtaṃ samānayāsiṃ kavacaṃ rathaṃ ca .. 52 ..
17.14.d:
अनेन वाक्येन सुराधिपस्तु चचाल कोपावरितस्तदानीम् ..
गजेति वज्रेति जगाद सूतं समानयासिं कवचं रथं च .. 52 ..
17.14.m: At these words, the lord of the gods trembled, seized by rage at that moment. / 'Elephant! Thunderbolt!' he said to his charioteer, 'Bring my sword, armor, and chariot!

17.14.s:
rathena sūryo maruto gajena vṛṣeṇa rudro mahiṣeṇa sauriḥ ..
vādyaṃtu vādyāni raṇāya me'dya caṇḍī gaṇeśāstvaritāḥ prayātu .. 53 ..
17.14.d:
रथेन सूर्यो मरुतो गजेन वृषेण रुद्रो महिषेण सौरिः ..
वाद्यंतु वाद्यानि रणाय मेऽद्य चण्डी गणेशास्त्वरिताः प्रयातु .. 53 ..
17.14.m: Let Sūrya [advance] in a chariot, the Maruts on an elephant, Rudra on a bull, Śauri on a buffalo! / Let the musical instruments sound for my battle today! Let Caṇḍī and the Gaṇeśas advance swiftly!'

17.14.s:
dṛṣṭvā surendraṃ saṃkruddhaṃ bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ..
ṛṣimadhye gato vidvānbabhāṣe samayocitam .. 54 ..
17.14.d:
दृष्ट्वा सुरेन्द्रं संक्रुद्धं बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः ..
ऋषिमध्ये गतो विद्वान्बभाषे समयोचितम् .. 54 ..
17.14.m: Seeing the lord of the gods utterly enraged, Bṛhaspati of noble intellect, / the learned one, entering among the seers, spoke words appropriate to the occasion:

17.14.s:
sāmādyā nītayaḥ proktāścatasro manunā purā ..
sāmasādhyeṣu kāryeṣu daṇḍastena na pātyatām .. 55 ..
17.14.d:
सामाद्या नीतयः प्रोक्ताश्चतस्रो मनुना पुरा ..
सामसाध्येषु कार्येषु दण्डस्तेन न पात्यताम् .. 55 ..
17.14.m: "Four policies, beginning with conciliation, were formerly proclaimed by Manu. / In matters that can be accomplished by conciliation, let not punishment be applied by him.

17.14.s:
ato hyupendrmāhūya maṃtrayantu surottamāḥ ..
tadadhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 56 ..
17.14.d:
अतो ह्युपेन्द्र्माहूय मंत्रयन्तु सुरोत्तमाः ..
तदधीनं जगत्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 56 ..
17.14.m: Therefore, having summoned Upendra, let the foremost of the gods deliberate. / Subservient to him is the entire world, the three worlds with all that moves and is still.

17.14.s:
vinaṣṭeṣu ca kāryeṣu tasya vācyaṃ śubhāśubham ..
sa eva prathamaṃ gacchetpṛthivyāṃ svārthasiddhaye .. 57 ..
17.14.d:
विनष्टेषु च कार्येषु तस्य वाच्यं शुभाशुभम् ..
स एव प्रथमं गच्छेत्पृथिव्यां स्वार्थसिद्धये .. 57 ..
17.14.m: And when matters have failed, good and bad should be stated to him. / He alone should go first to the earth for the attainment of your purpose."

17.14.s:
tatheti devairvijñaptastathā cakre sureśvaraḥ ..
mandare'tha girau viṣṇuḥ satyalokātsamāgataḥ .. 58 ..
17.14.d:
तथेति देवैर्विज्ञप्तस्तथा चक्रे सुरेश्वरः ..
मन्दरेऽथ गिरौ विष्णुः सत्यलोकात्समागतः .. 58 ..
17.14.m: "So be it!" Indra, thus petitioned by the gods, did accordingly. / Then Viṣṇu came to Mount Mandara from Satyaloka.

17.14.s:
ṛṣayastatra te yāṃtu samānetuṃ janārddanam ..
ityukto nāradaḥ svargātsnātuṃ prāptaḥ sa mandare .. 59 ..
17.14.d:
ऋषयस्तत्र ते यांतु समानेतुं जनार्द्दनम् ..
इत्युक्तो नारदः स्वर्गात्स्नातुं प्राप्तः स मन्दरे .. 59 ..
17.14.m: Let those seers go there to bring Janārdana. / Having been told this, Nārada arrived at Mandara from heaven to bathe.

17.14.s:
gautamo'trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro'tha kaśyapaḥ ..
jamadagnirvasiṣṭhaśca saṃprāptā harimandire .. 7.2.14.60 ..
17.14.d:
गौतमोऽत्रिर्भरद्वाजो विश्वामित्रोऽथ कश्यपः ..
जमदग्निर्वसिष्ठश्च संप्राप्ता हरिमन्दिरे .. 7.2.14.60 ..
17.14.m: Gautama, Atri, Bharadvāja, Viśvāmitra, then Kaśyapa, / Jamadagni, and Vasiṣṭha arrived at the temple of Hari.

17.14.s:
girau gaṃgā jale snānaṃ saṃdhyāṃ cakre sa nāradaḥ ..
yāvadāste tadā hṛṣṭā vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ .. 61 ..
17.14.d:
गिरौ गंगा जले स्नानं संध्यां चक्रे स नारदः ..
यावदास्ते तदा हृष्टा वालखिल्या महर्षयः .. 61 ..
17.14.m: Nārada bathed in the water of the Gaṅgā on the mountain and performed his twilight devotions. / While he was staying there, the delighted great seers, the Vālakhilyas,

17.14.s:
vinayenābhivādyātha kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ ..
ṛṣayo mandare prāptā viṣṇuṃ netuṃ surālaye .. 62 ..
17.14.d:
विनयेनाभिवाद्याथ कथयामास नारदः ..
ऋषयो मन्दरे प्राप्ता विष्णुं नेतुं सुरालये .. 62 ..
17.14.m: having bowed with humility, Nārada said to them: / "The seers have arrived at Mandara to take Viṣṇu to the abode of the gods.

17.14.s:
ṛṣayo darśanaṃ karttuṃ bhavatāmapi yujyate ..
tadetadvacanaṃ śrutvā harṣitāste maharṣayaḥ .. 63 ..
17.14.d:
ऋषयो दर्शनं कर्त्तुं भवतामपि युज्यते ..
तदेतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षितास्ते महर्षयः .. 63 ..
17.14.m: It is fitting for you too, O seers, to have his darśana." / Hearing these words of his, those great seers were delighted.

17.14.s:
aṃguṣṭhaparvamātrāṃstānvāmanānharimandire..
gatāngaṃgājale snātuṃ vālakhilyānpuro hariḥ.. 64..
17.14.d:
अंगुष्ठपर्वमात्रांस्तान्वामनान्हरिमन्दिरे..
गतान्गंगाजले स्नातुं वालखिल्यान्पुरो हरिः.. 64..
17.14.m: Those Vālakhilyas, dwarfs the size of a thumb-joint, / having gone to bathe in the water of the Gaṅgā, Hari [saw] before him in his temple.

17.14.s:
jahāsa vāmanānsarvānbhāvikāryabalāttataḥ..
brahmaputrā vālakhilyāḥ sarve te śaṃsitavratāḥ .. 65 ..
17.14.d:
जहास वामनान्सर्वान्भाविकार्यबलात्ततः..
ब्रह्मपुत्रा वालखिल्याः सर्वे ते शंसितव्रताः .. 65 ..
17.14.m: He laughed at all the dwarfs on account of the power of what was destined to happen. / All those sons of Brahmā, the Vālakhilyas, were observed in their vows;

17.14.s:
lajjānvitāḥ krodhaparā uccairūcuḥ parasparam ..
kenāpi devakāryeṇa vāmano'yaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 66 ..
17.14.d:
लज्जान्विताः क्रोधपरा उच्चैरूचुः परस्परम् ..
केनापि देवकार्येण वामनोऽयं भविष्यति .. 66 ..
17.14.m: filled with shame and seized with anger, they spoke loudly to one another: / "For some work of the gods, this one shall become a dwarf!"

17.14.s:
ṛṣibhirvi ṣṇunā sarve pratibodhya prasāditāḥ ..
bhāgyamokṣaḥ kadā viṣṇorbhaviṣyati taducyatām ..67..
17.14.d:
ऋषिभिर्वि ष्णुना सर्वे प्रतिबोध्य प्रसादिताः ..
भाग्यमोक्षः कदा विष्णोर्भविष्यति तदुच्यताम् ..67..
17.14.m: Being enlightened by the seers and Viṣṇu, all of them were propitiated. / "Let it be stated when the liberation from this destiny shall be for Viṣṇu."

17.14.s:
prabhāsādadhikaṃ kṣetraṃ yadā vastrāpathaṃ bhavet ..
bhaviṣyati tadā vṛddhirdhruvamaṇḍalavyāpinī ..
tathā vastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati yavādhikam .. 68 ..
17.14.d:
प्रभासादधिकं क्षेत्रं यदा वस्त्रापथं भवेत् ..
भविष्यति तदा वृद्धिर्ध्रुवमण्डलव्यापिनी ..
तथा वस्त्रापथं क्षेत्रं भविष्यति यवाधिकम् .. 68 ..
17.14.m: [The seers said:] / "When the sacred field of Vastrāpatha becomes greater than Prabhāsa, / then his growth shall take place, pervading the circle of the Pole Star; / and thus the sacred field of Vastrāpatha shall be greater by a barley-corn.

17.14.s:
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ doṣamukto bhaviṣyati ..
asādhyasādhanī śaktirbhaviṣyati sthirā tava .. 69 ..
17.14.d:
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं दोषमुक्तो भविष्यति ..
असाध्यसाधनी शक्तिर्भविष्यति स्थिरा तव .. 69 ..
17.14.m: Having seen the god Someśvara, he will be freed from the fault. / The power to accomplish the impossible shall be firmly yours.

17.14.s:
vastrāpathe somanāthaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ..
indropendrau samāliṃgyāthāsīnau tau varāsane .. 7.2.14.70 .. ..
17.14.d:
वस्त्रापथे सोमनाथं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ..
इन्द्रोपेन्द्रौ समालिंग्याथासीनौ तौ वरासने .. 7.2.14.70 .. ..
17.14.m: He who sees Somanātha in Vastrāpatha, he truly sees." / Having embraced Indra and Upendra, they both sat upon an excellent seat.

17.14.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
kiṃ te kāryaṃ devarāja tadavaśyaṃ karomyaham .. 71 ..
17.14.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
किं ते कार्यं देवराज तदवश्यं करोम्यहम् .. 71 ..
17.14.m: Viṣṇu said: / "What is your task, O King of the gods? I will certainly do that."

17.14.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
hiraṇyakaśiporvaṃśe balirdaityo mahā balaḥ ..
tenedaṃ sakalaṃ vyāptaṃ devā yajñabhujaḥ kṛtāḥ .. 72 ..
17.14.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
हिरण्यकशिपोर्वंशे बलिर्दैत्यो महा बलः ..
तेनेदं सकलं व्याप्तं देवा यज्ञभुजः कृताः .. 72 ..
17.14.m: Indra said: / "In the lineage of Hiraṇyakaśipu there is the very powerful Daitya Bali. / By him all this has been pervaded; the gods have been made to eat only sacrificial offerings.

17.14.s:
devaloke bhūmiloko gataḥ sarvo'pi keśava ..
yāvanno vikṛtiṃ yāti pūrvavairamanusmaran ..
bhraṣṭarājyo balistāvatpātālamadhitiṣṭhatu .. 73 ..
17.14.d:
देवलोके भूमिलोको गतः सर्वोऽपि केशव ..
यावन्नो विकृतिं याति पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ..
भ्रष्टराज्यो बलिस्तावत्पातालमधितिष्ठतु .. 73 ..
17.14.m: The entire earthly realm has passed into the divine realm, O Keśava. / Before he undergoes transformation remembering the former enmity, / let Bali, fallen from kingship, reside in Pātāla.

17.14.s: sūryasomānvaye kaścidrājā bhavatu bhūtale .. 74 ..
17.14.d: सूर्यसोमान्वये कश्चिद्राजा भवतु भूतले .. 74 ..
17.14.m: Let some king born in the solar or lunar lineage arise on the surface of the earth."

17.14.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā svayaṃ saṃcintya cetasā ..
tathā kariṣye taṃ procya munīnprāha janārdanaḥ .. 75 ..
17.14.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स्वयं संचिन्त्य चेतसा ..
तथा करिष्ये तं प्रोच्य मुनीन्प्राह जनार्दनः .. 75 ..
17.14.m: Sārasvata said: / Having heard these words and considered them in his mind, / saying to him, "I will do so," Janārdana addressed the sages:

17.14.s:
ṛṣayastatra gacchaṃtu kārayantu mahāmakham ..
ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi sādhayiṣyāmi taṃ balim .. 76 ..
17.14.d:
ऋषयस्तत्र गच्छंतु कारयन्तु महामखम् ..
अहं तत्रागमिष्यामि साधयिष्यामि तं बलिम् .. 76 ..
17.14.m: "Let the seers go there and have a great sacrifice performed. / I shall go there and subdue that Bali."

17.14.s:
ityuktā munayaḥ sarve gatāste yajñamaṇḍape ..
dvādaśāho mahāyajñaḥ prārabdhaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ .. 77 ..
17.14.d:
इत्युक्ता मुनयः सर्वे गतास्ते यज्ञमण्डपे ..
द्वादशाहो महायज्ञः प्रारब्धः सर्वदक्षिणः .. 77 ..
17.14.m: Having been addressed thus, all the sages went to the sacrificial pavilion. / A great twelve-day sacrifice with fees given to all was begun.

17.14.s:
surāṣṭradeśaṃ vikhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ nṛpa ..
tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge baleḥ siddhaṃ mahāpuram .. 78 ..
17.14.d:
सुराष्ट्रदेशं विख्यातं क्षेत्रं वस्त्रापथं नृप ..
तस्य दक्षिणदिग्भागे बलेः सिद्धं महापुरम् .. 78 ..
17.14.m: The sacred field of Vastrāpatha, famed in the region of Surāṣṭra, O king— / on its southern side was the accomplished great city of Bali.

17.14.s:
kṣetrādbahiḥ samārabdho yajñaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ ..
śukreṇāmantritāḥ sarve munayo yajñakarmaṇi ..
atihṛṣṭo baliryajñe dadau dānānyanekadhā .. 79 ..
17.14.d:
क्षेत्राद्बहिः समारब्धो यज्ञः सर्वस्वदक्षिणः ..
शुक्रेणामन्त्रिताः सर्वे मुनयो यज्ञकर्मणि ..
अतिहृष्टो बलिर्यज्ञे ददौ दानान्यनेकधा .. 79 ..
17.14.m: Outside the sacred field, the sacrifice was begun with one's entire property given as fee. / All the sages were invited by Śukra for the sacrificial rite. / Exceedingly delighted at the sacrifice, Bali gave various gifts.

17.14.s:
svarṇapātreṣu sarveṣu dīyate bhojanaṃ bahu ..
atithirbrāhmaṇo vidvānsarvasvenāpi pūjyate ..
dānādyajño bhavetpūrṇo dānahīno vṛthā bhavet .. 7.2.14.80 ..
17.14.d:
स्वर्णपात्रेषु सर्वेषु दीयते भोजनं बहु ..
अतिथिर्ब्राह्मणो विद्वान्सर्वस्वेनापि पूज्यते ..
दानाद्यज्ञो भवेत्पूर्णो दानहीनो वृथा भवेत् .. 7.2.14.80 ..
17.14.m: In all gold vessels, abundant food is given. / The guest and the learned brahmin are honored even with all one's possessions. / Through giving a sacrifice becomes complete; lacking gifts, it becomes in vain.

17.14.s:
etasminneva kāle tu viṣṇurvāmanatāṃ gataḥ ..
madhyadeśe caturvedo brāhmaṇastīrthayātrikaḥ ..
mahodaro hrasvabhujaḥ khañjapādo mahāśirāḥ .. 81 ..
17.14.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु विष्णुर्वामनतां गतः ..
मध्यदेशे चतुर्वेदो ब्राह्मणस्तीर्थयात्रिकः ..
महोदरो ह्रस्वभुजः खञ्जपादो महाशिराः .. 81 ..
17.14.m: At that very time, Viṣṇu assumed the form of a dwarf (Vāmana). / In the Madhyadeśa, [he became] a four-Veda-knowing brahmin, a pilgrim to sacred fords, / big-bellied, short-armed, lame-footed, with a large head,

17.14.s:
mahāhanuḥ sthūlajaṃghaḥ sthūlagrīvo'tilaṃpaṭaḥ ..
śvetavastro baddhaśikhaśchatropānatkamaṇḍalūn .. 82 ..
17.14.d:
महाहनुः स्थूलजंघः स्थूलग्रीवोऽतिलंपटः ..
श्वेतवस्त्रो बद्धशिखश्छत्रोपानत्कमण्डलून् .. 82 ..
17.14.m: with large jaws, thick calves, a stout neck, extremely restless, / wearing white clothes, with his topknot tied, carrying an umbrella, shoes, and a water-pot.

17.14.s:
draṣṭuṃ tīrthānyanekāni babhrāma sa mahītale ..
surāṣṭradeśe saṃprāptaḥ kṣetre vastrāpathe dvijaḥ .. 83 ..
17.14.d:
द्रष्टुं तीर्थान्यनेकानि बभ्राम स महीतले ..
सुराष्ट्रदेशे संप्राप्तः क्षेत्रे वस्त्रापथे द्विजः .. 83 ..
17.14.m: To see many sacred fords, he wandered the earth. / The twice-born arrived in the land of Surāṣṭra, in the sacred field of Vastrāpatha.

17.14.s:
svarṇarekhā nadītīre ciṃtayāmāsa vāmanaḥ ..
prathamaṃ kiṃ bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmi someśvaraṃ śivam .. 84 ..
17.14.d:
स्वर्णरेखा नदीतीरे चिंतयामास वामनः ..
प्रथमं किं भवं दृष्ट्वा यामि सोमेश्वरं शिवम् .. 84 ..
17.14.m: On the bank of the Svarṇarekhā river, Vāmana reflected: / “Shall I first see Bhava and then go to Someśvara, the auspicious Śiva?

17.14.s:
atha someśvaraṃ pūjya paścādyāsyāmi mandaram ..
iti cintāparo bhūtvā kṛtyaṃ sañcintya cetasā ..
atra sthitaḥ somanāthaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi niścitam .. 85 ..
17.14.d:
अथ सोमेश्वरं पूज्य पश्चाद्यास्यामि मन्दरम् ..
इति चिन्तापरो भूत्वा कृत्यं सञ्चिन्त्य चेतसा ..
अत्र स्थितः सोमनाथं पूजयिष्यामि निश्चितम् .. 85 ..
17.14.m: Or having worshipped Someśvara, shall I go afterwards to Mandara?” / Having thus become absorbed in thought, and having considered in his mind what was to be done, / [he decided:] “Remaining here, I shall certainly worship Somanātha.

17.14.s:
vastrāpathe mahākṣetre bhavaṃ someśvaraṃ vṛthā ..
pūjayaṃti janā nityaṃ tathā kāryaṃ mayā dhuvam .. 86 ..
17.14.d:
वस्त्रापथे महाक्षेत्रे भवं सोमेश्वरं वृथा ..
पूजयंति जना नित्यं तथा कार्यं मया धुवम् .. 86 ..
17.14.m: In the great sacred field of Vastrāpatha, people continually worship Bhava Someśvara in vain; / surely, [proper worship] must be performed by me.

17.14.s:
deśānāmuttamo deśo girīṇāmuttamo giriḥ ..
kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ nadīnāmuttamā sarit .. 87 ..
17.14.d:
देशानामुत्तमो देशो गिरीणामुत्तमो गिरिः ..
क्षेत्राणामुत्तमं क्षेत्रं नदीनामुत्तमा सरित् .. 87 ..
17.14.m: Of all countries, this is the best country; of all mountains, this is the best mountain; / of all sacred fields, this is the best sacred field; of all rivers, this is the best river;

17.14.s:
divyaṃ vanaṃ vanānāṃ tu devānāmuttamo bhavaḥ ..
yadā someśvaro devo bhūmiṃ bhittvā bhaviṣyati .. 88 ..
17.14.d:
दिव्यं वनं वनानां तु देवानामुत्तमो भवः ..
यदा सोमेश्वरो देवो भूमिं भित्त्वा भविष्यति .. 88 ..
17.14.m: of all forests, this is the divine forest; and of all gods, Bhava is the highest. / When the god Someśvara bursts through the earth and appears,

17.14.s:
tadāmramaṇḍale divyaṃ kṣetrametadyavādhikam ..
caitra śuklacaturdaśyāmagnisādhanatatparaḥ .. 89 ..
17.14.d:
तदाम्रमण्डले दिव्यं क्षेत्रमेतद्यवाधिकम् ..
चैत्र शुक्लचतुर्दश्यामग्निसाधनतत्परः .. 89 ..
17.14.m: then in Āmramaṇḍala this divine sacred field will surpass [all others by far].” / On the fourteenth day of the bright half of Caitra, intent upon practicing the discipline of fires,

17.14.s:
ūrdhvabāhuḥ sūryakāle bhavaṃ tāvatsa paśyati ..
madhyaṃdinaṃ paraṃ yāte dinanāthe vilaṃbite .. 7.2.14.90 ..
17.14.d:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुः सूर्यकाले भवं तावत्स पश्यति ..
मध्यंदिनं परं याते दिननाथे विलंबिते .. 7.2.14.90 ..
17.14.m: with upraised arms at the time of the sun, he beheld Bhava; / when the lord of day had passed midday and was lingering,

17.14.s:
agni tāpāṃgasaṃtaptastāvatpaśyati śaṃkaram ..
somanāthaṃ śivaṃ śāṃtaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam ..
arghyeṇa puṣpamiśreṇa jalamiśreṇa bhāmini .. 91 .. ..
17.14.d:
अग्नि तापांगसंतप्तस्तावत्पश्यति शंकरम् ..
सोमनाथं शिवं शांतं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् ..
अर्घ्येण पुष्पमिश्रेण जलमिश्रेण भामिनि .. 91 .. ..
17.14.m: his limbs scorched by the heat of the fire, he then beheld Śaṃkara, / Somanātha, the peaceful Śiva worshipped by all the gods, / [and offered worship] with water for guest-offering mixed with flowers and with water, O fair lady.

17.14.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
bhūmiṃ bhittvātha deveśaḥ svayaṃ someśvaraḥ sthitaḥ ..
liṃgarūpo mahādevo yāvadābrahmavāsaram .. 92 ..
17.14.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
भूमिं भित्त्वाथ देवेशः स्वयं सोमेश्वरः स्थितः ..
लिंगरूपो महादेवो यावदाब्रह्मवासरम् .. 92 ..
17.14.m: Sārasvata said: / Then, having burst through the earth, the lord of gods, Someśvara himself, stood / in the form of a liṅga, Mahādeva, for as long as a day of Brahmā lasts.

17.14.s:
.. someśvara uvāca .. ..
siddhastvaṃ matprasādena kāryaṃ siddhaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
ityukto vāmano devaṃ pratyuvāca maheśvaram .. 93 ..
17.14.d:
.. सोमेश्वर उवाच .. ..
सिद्धस्त्वं मत्प्रसादेन कार्यं सिद्धं भविष्यति ..
इत्युक्तो वामनो देवं प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरम् .. 93 ..
17.14.m: Someśvara said: / “You are accomplished by my grace; your purpose will be accomplished.” / Addressed thus, Vāmana replied to the god Maheśvara:

17.14.s:
.. vāmana uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama ..
tadā'tra liṃge sthātavyamastu divyaṃ puro mama .. 94 ..
17.14.d:
.. वामन उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टो महादेव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
तदाऽत्र लिंगे स्थातव्यमस्तु दिव्यं पुरो मम .. 94 ..
17.14.m: Vāmana said: / “If you are pleased, O Mahādeva, if a boon is to be granted to me, / then you must dwell here in this divine liṅga before me.

17.14.s:
yastu svāyaṃbhuvaṃ liṃgaṃ vāmane nagare mama ..
pūjayiṣyati brahmaghno goghno vā bālaghātakaḥ .. 95 ..
17.14.d:
यस्तु स्वायंभुवं लिंगं वामने नगरे मम ..
पूजयिष्यति ब्रह्मघ्नो गोघ्नो वा बालघातकः .. 95 ..
17.14.m: Whoever will worship this self-manifest liṅga in my city of Vāmana— / whether a killer of a brahmin, a killer of a cow, or a slayer of a child,

17.14.s:
gurudrohī svarṇacoro mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ..
nirdoṣaḥ pūjayedyastu sakṛtsomeśvaraṃ haram .. 96 ..
17.14.d:
गुरुद्रोही स्वर्णचोरो मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ..
निर्दोषः पूजयेद्यस्तु सकृत्सोमेश्वरं हरम् .. 96 ..
17.14.m: a traitor to his guru, or a gold thief—is freed from all sins. / And whoever, being faultless, worships Hara Someśvara even once,

17.14.s:
mṛto vimānamāruhya divyastrīpariveṣṭitaḥ ..
saṃstūyamāno dikpālairyātu svarge śivālaye .. 97 ..
17.14.d:
मृतो विमानमारुह्य दिव्यस्त्रीपरिवेष्टितः ..
संस्तूयमानो दिक्पालैर्यातु स्वर्गे शिवालये .. 97 ..
17.14.m: having died, having mounted an aerial chariot, surrounded by celestial women, / being praised by the guardians of the directions, let him go to the abode of Śiva in heaven.

17.14.s:
brahmalokamatikramya rudraloke sa gacchatu ..
tathetyuktvā somanāthastatraivāntaradhīyata .. 98 ..
17.14.d:
ब्रह्मलोकमतिक्रम्य रुद्रलोके स गच्छतु ..
तथेत्युक्त्वा सोमनाथस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .. 98 ..
17.14.m: Passing beyond the world of Brahmā, let him go to the world of Rudra.” / Saying, “So be it,” Somanātha vanished right there.

17.14.s:
prakāśya vāmano ligaṃ somanāthaṃ svayaṃbhuvam ..
prāptajñāno labdhavṛddhiryayau draṣṭuṃ bhavaṃ haram .. 99 ..
17.14.d:
प्रकाश्य वामनो लिगं सोमनाथं स्वयंभुवम् ..
प्राप्तज्ञानो लब्धवृद्धिर्ययौ द्रष्टुं भवं हरम् .. 99 ..
17.14.m: Having revealed the self-manifest liṅga Somanātha, / Vāmana, having obtained knowledge and acquired prosperity, went to see Bhava, Hara.

17.14.s:
gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ svarṇarekhājale sthitāḥ ..
etāṃ someśvarotpattiṃ ye śṛṇvaṃti narāḥ striyaḥ ..
sarvapāpakṣayasteṣāṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..7.2.14.100 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye someśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 14 ..
17.14.d:
गंगाद्याः सरितः सर्वाः स्वर्णरेखाजले स्थिताः ..
एतां सोमेश्वरोत्पत्तिं ये शृण्वंति नराः स्त्रियः ..
सर्वपापक्षयस्तेषां जायते नात्र संशयः ..7.2.14.100 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे द्वितीये वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सोमेश्वरोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः .. 14 ..
17.14.m:
All the rivers, beginning with the Gaṅgā, abide in the waters of the Svarṇarekhā. / Those men and women who hear of this origin of Someśvara / attain the destruction of all sins; there is no doubt about this.
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named “The Description of the Origin of Someśvara,” in the second [sub-section], the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

17.15.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
athāsau vāmano vipro labdhajñāno bhavārcane ..
jagāma tadvanaṃ ramyaṃ gire raivatakasya yat .. 1 ..
17.15.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
अथासौ वामनो विप्रो लब्धज्ञानो भवार्चने ..
जगाम तद्वनं रम्यं गिरे रैवतकस्य यत् .. 1 ..
17.15.m: Sārasvata said: / Then that brahmin Vāmana, having attained knowledge in the worship of Bhava, / went to that delightful forest belonging to Mount Raivataka,

17.15.s:
yatra vṛkṣā bahuvidhā dīrghaśākhāḥ phalānvitāḥ ..
vaṭodumbarabilvāśca sarjārjunakadaṃbakāḥ .. 2 ..
17.15.d:
यत्र वृक्षा बहुविधा दीर्घशाखाः फलान्विताः ..
वटोदुम्बरबिल्वाश्च सर्जार्जुनकदंबकाः .. 2 ..
17.15.m: where there were trees of many kinds, with long branches and bearing fruit: / banyans, udumbaras, bilvas, sarjas, arjunas, kadambas,

17.15.s:
palāśāśvatthaniṃbāśca dhavāṭīvāruṇīdrumāḥ ..
śamīkaṃkolaliṃbāṃśca bījapūrī ca dāḍimaḥ ..3..
17.15.d:
पलाशाश्वत्थनिंबाश्च धवाटीवारुणीद्रुमाः ..
शमीकंकोललिंबांश्च बीजपूरी च दाडिमः ..3..
17.15.m: palāśas, aśvatthas, nimba trees, dhavas, aṭīvāruṇīs, / śamī, kaṅkola, lime, bījapūra, and pomegranate trees,

17.15.s:
badarī niṃbakaḥ pūgaḥ kadalī śallakī śivā..
tālahiṃtālaśirasā bījakāvaṃśakhādirāḥ ..4..
17.15.d:
बदरी निंबकः पूगः कदली शल्लकी शिवा..
तालहिंतालशिरसा बीजकावंशखादिराः ..4..
17.15.m: jujubes, lemon, areca palms, plantains, śallakīs, auspicious trees, / palmyra and hintāla palms, śirasas, bījakas, bamboos, and khadira trees,

17.15.s:
ajagāsanagāgucchā iṃgudīkoraveṃgudāḥ ..
brahmavṛkṣāḥ kurubakāḥ karaṃjāḥ putrajīvinaḥ.. .. 5 ..
17.15.d:
अजगासनगागुच्छा इंगुदीकोरवेंगुदाः ..
ब्रह्मवृक्षाः कुरुबकाः करंजाः पुत्रजीविनः.. .. 5 ..
17.15.m: ajagas, asanas, clumps [of reeds], iṅgudīs, koraveṅgudas, / palāśas (brahmavṛkṣa), kurubakas, karañjas, and putrajīvas,

17.15.s:
aṃkollāḥ pāribhadrāśca kalaṃbāḥ panasāstathā ..
ujjvalāśca haridrāśca gaṃgaḍīvāyavā drumāḥ .. 6 ..
17.15.d:
अंकोल्लाः पारिभद्राश्च कलंबाः पनसास्तथा ..
उज्ज्वलाश्च हरिद्राश्च गंगडीवायवा द्रुमाः .. 6 ..
17.15.m: aṅkollas, coral trees (pāribhadra), kalambas, and jackfruit trees, / bright ones, turmeric plants, gaṅgaḍīs, and vāyava trees,

17.15.s:
tesuṇḍakāḥ śirīṣāśca kharjūrīkaravaṃdikāḥ..
sevālī śālmalī śālā madhūkāśca vibhītakāḥ ..7..
17.15.d:
तेसुण्डकाः शिरीषाश्च खर्जूरीकरवंदिकाः..
सेवाली शाल्मली शाला मधूकाश्च विभीतकाः ..7..
17.15.m: tesuṇḍakas, śirīṣas, date palms, and karavandas, / sevālīs, silk-cotton trees, śālas, madhūkas, and vibhītakas,

17.15.s:
harītakyaḥ kaṭāhāśca karyaṣṭā āṭarūṣakāḥ ..
vikacchavaḥ kapitthāśca rohiṇīvetrakadrumāḥ ..8..
17.15.d:
हरीतक्यः कटाहाश्च कर्यष्टा आटरूषकाः ..
विकच्छवः कपित्थाश्च रोहिणीवेत्रकद्रुमाः ..8..
17.15.m: myrobalans (harītakī), kaṭāhas, karyaṣṭas, and āṭarūṣakas, / vikacchavas, wood-apples, rohiṇīs, and canes,

17.15.s:
madanaphalānirguṇḍīpāṭalānaṃdipādapāḥ ..
lavaṃgailālavalyaśca santānā agarudrumāḥ .. 9 ..
17.15.d:
मदनफलानिर्गुण्डीपाटलानंदिपादपाः ..
लवंगैलालवल्यश्च सन्ताना अगरुद्रुमाः .. 9 ..
17.15.m: emetic nut trees (madanaphala), nirguṇḍīs, pāṭalas, nandi trees, / cloves, cardamoms, lavalīs, santānas, and agallochum trees,

17.15.s:
śrīkhaṇḍakarpūranagāḥ kalpavṛkṣā nagotamāḥ ..
vāmanena tadā dṛṣṭāśchāyāvṛkṣāḥ surārcitāḥ .. 7.2.15.10 ..
17.15.d:
श्रीखण्डकर्पूरनगाः कल्पवृक्षा नगोतमाः ..
वामनेन तदा दृष्टाश्छायावृक्षाः सुरार्चिताः .. 7.2.15.10 ..
17.15.m: sandalwood and camphor trees, wish-fulfilling trees, the best of trees; / shade-providing trees worshipped by gods were then seen by Vāmana,

17.15.s:
udayāstamane yeṣāṃ chāyā na pratihanyate ..
teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 11 ..
17.15.d:
उदयास्तमने येषां छाया न प्रतिहन्यते ..
तेषां दर्शनमात्रेण सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 11 ..
17.15.m: whose shadow is never obstructed at sunrise or at sunset; / by merely beholding them, the destruction of all sins occurs.

17.15.s:
ye janāḥ puṇyakarmāṇasteṣāṃ te dṛṣṭigocarāḥ ..
etānpaśyanyayau vṛkṣāṃstato raivatakaṃ girim .. 12 ..
17.15.d:
ये जनाः पुण्यकर्माणस्तेषां ते दृष्टिगोचराः ..
